RolotiaSwimsuit01.Profile:
Growing up in the mountains of Bergaria, Rolotia knew only chilly springs, frost-kissed autumns, and winters so bitter they killed all memory of warmth.

Now that she's made it to the beach for the first time, she's as thrilled as she is overwhelmed. The sun shines so strongly she can feel its rays brush her skin. The sea stretches from her feet to the horizon, free and untamed, nothing like the icy peaks that shadowed her childhood.

If this is summer, she never wants it to end.
RolotiaSwimsuit01.GachaIntro:
"What a gorgeous day!
If only it could last forever..."

RolotiaSwimsuit02.Name: Rolotia
RolotiaSwimsuit02.Profile:
Rolotia loves the beach. She'd much rather race across golden sand than harsh, glinting snow. Unfortunately, sunshine and her pale northern skin don't get along well.

After that first day, which saw her going to bed a painful shade of crimson, Rolotia has come prepared. She persuaded Rizette to part with some sun-cloaking cream in exchange for a few magically extended moments with Finn. She made herself an oasis of shade with her umbrella. But what is she to do when she wants to join her friends in the water?

Perhaps a hat can keep the sun away.
RolotiaSwimsuit02.Profile_Ascended:
The close of her vacation has filled Rolotia with a surprising melancholy. As the Avatar of Time, she's learned well that all good things must end. Surely a summer is nothing to mourn.

Yet each wave heralds their return to war, to worry, to reality. Could she ask Chronos to keep them here forever, suspended in a perfect summer's day, never to know suffering again?

No. The Primordial of Time would never allow it. As long as they draw breath, all living things must change. That is the foremost law of time.

But as long as she keeps the memory in her heart, Rolotia's first summer need never truly end.

ElminaSwimsuit01.Name: Elmina
ElminaSwimsuit01.Profile:
People stare at Elmina no matter where she goes.

In human kingdoms, they stare because she's an elf. In the fair-skinned north, her tan draws curious attention. And when she's on the beach...well. She could do without the open-mouthed stares, but she likes bikinis best, so that's what she'll wear.

To tell the truth, being noticed takes some getting used to for a former street kid. That's why she learned to be stealthy. Keeping invisible saved her hide too many times to count, but it's no way to live. Not anymore.

She can slip into shadow whenever she wants. Why not enjoy a day in the sun?
ElminaSwimsuit01.GachaIntro:
"Well, don't just stand there.
Aren't you going to join me?"

ElminaSwimsuit02.Profile:
Elmina didn't grow up with tropical heat, but she thinks it suits her. Humidity works wonders for her complexion, and the sun brings out the natural highlights in her hair. She doesn't have to worry about burns much either, though Callen still lectures her until she puts on proper protection.

Still, when the sun grows too bright even for her, she enjoys a cool retreat into the forest. Walking through the shade at the hottest time of day is a rare pleasure for one used to shivering in the cold.

And stumbling upon an unexpected waterfall? That's the kind of memory that begs to be shared with another.
ElminaSwimsuit02.Profile_Ascended:
Elves can hold their breath five times longer than most other races. Did you know that? Elmina finds most people don't.

It's a handy talent, one that's saved her life more than once. Not because she was much of a swimmer in her childhood, but because a little thief frequently finds herself in situations where a single audible breath could kill her.

Even these days, she feels a strange kind of peace when she isn't breathing. In those moments before her lungs start to burn, she knows she's safe.

She supposes she could stay beneath the waves, in a safe and breathless haven. But she doesn't need to anymore. Her friends have her back now, and they don't want her to be silent.

The witches of Lumains know what it is to be feared, but that doesn't stop them from fearing. Even among outcasts, those witches who have taken on the features of a dragon are shunned. She's never told anyone how she got her horns and her lone wing. She's never told anyone how she lost her eye. It wouldn't matter anyway. The truth rarely changes anyone's mind.

Aria, like all other Primordials, was born at the foundation of her world. Gifted with power over death, her duty was to judge mortal souls as they passed to the afterlife. With a touch, she could live each person's greatest triumphs and vilest sins, and with a swing of her scythe, she could snuff out any mortal life she pleased.

Aria could never understand why the living feared her. Unlike other Primordials, she wandered their world as she pleased, desperate to understand those she would one day judge. But all who saw her ran and cursed her name, beseeching their gods to protect them from the specter of death.

Eventually, a Goddess answered their prayers.

Aria doesn't remember much of her world's first True God. She's lived a long, long time, and shared too many memories to keep them all straight. But she does remember the day Orcanix first arrived. It was the day she realized she, too, might someday die.

The Undead Goddess commanded her hordes to hunt down and destroy the Primordial of Death, the one power capable of opposing her. Aria begged the mortals for shelter, but all turned her away, too terrified of Orcanix's assassins to risk her ire.

Only one man proved brave enough to protect her. A noble lord from the petty kingdom of Sanga, who foresaw the destruction to come.
GothGirl02.Profile_Ascended:
The lord and his trusted bodyguard offered Aria their hospitality, letting her do as she liked within their lands. At first, Aria mistrusted them, too used to mortal terror to accept their kindness blindly. But after years of their unflinching protection in the face of the undead, her legendarily prickly shell gradually gave way.

After an encounter with Orcanix's assassins left the lord's family dead, she decided she could no longer endanger them with her presence. She sealed herself inside her Primordial realm, asking her guardians to summon her only at their most desperate. Her imprisonment would ensure Orcanix never created a world without death, and more importantly, it would keep the two of them safe.

She would just have to get used to being alone again.

IkemenSamurai01.Profile:
Those who carry the royal blood of Sanga inherit two vows: a vow to protect their homeland, and a vow to guard the shrine of the Death Primordial.

Since birth, Ryouma has borne these vows, not that anyone knows. As a bastard, his blood is as much a secret as the stone door beneath the shogun's palace, the gateway between the world of the living and the dead. His mother raised him to live as a shadow, silently slipping along behind those in the light.

Perhaps, if he had inherited his father's wisdom instead of his pride, he could have obeyed her. But Ryouma was born a warrior through and through, and thus he sought one day to hunt the dragon with no name.

and ever shall your blade strike true."

IkemenSamurai02.FullName: Ryouma - Warrior of the Nameless Beast
IkemenSamurai02.Profile:
The ancient dragons of Erden bore grand names: Fornaxos, Kaidaros, Altaireon, Diabolos. All were silenced when the Goddess came, never to be spoken again. Only the dragon who slithered between the stars survived to see the new world.

Ryouma located this beast in his mountain lair, determined to prove his blade could best a dragon. He gave the beast a good fight, but in the end, could not overcome his nimble grace and speed. Satisfied with his effort, he submitted himself to a warrior's death, certain no one he left behind would miss him.

The dragon, having glimpsed the young warrior's true potential, refused to kill him, and instead made him his apprentice.
IkemenSamurai02.Profile_Ascended:
When Ryouma mastered the dragon's sword technique, he honored him by sharing his true name at last, then bid him return to his kingdom. At first, the people marveled at his skill, forcing the shogun to honor him with a place among his guard.

But honor breeds resentment, and shadows wither in the sun. When the time came for Ryouma's companions to cover his flank, they abandoned him instead.

All the mastery in the world cannot turn one blade into ten. As ever, he fought valiantly, but this time, the proud dragon warrior met his end.

At least, so the legend goes. Little do the storytellers know that samurai and his nameless dragon live still, preserved from death by powers beyond their control, destined to one day meet again.

No one knows what made the Tuathan volcano erupt after so long lying dormant. Argento, ancient smith of the Aeon Lords, has been sure to keep it that way. A secret like the creation of homunculi should only be shared with worthy minds, and with the passing of Ossia's erstwhile creator, he can think of no one in the world who deserves it.

He has resurrected the poor thing, of course. Without a soul, returning a body to life is a simple thing. Frustratingly, her power over all six elements seems to have fled. But he has never known a setback he can't overcome.

Ossia's curiosity is as immense as her thirst for vengeance. He can make a weapon of her yet.

In the native Tuathan tongue, Kau Lana translates to 'born of the wind and waves.' One can easily see how these dragons earned such a name. Equally agile in the sky and the sea, the Kau Lana struck fear into the ancient Tuathan islanders, who rarely ventured out to sea despite their reliance on it for food.

Fortunately, not all Tuathans cowered before the dragons. According to legend, a chieftain by the name of Kaleiha ascended Tuatha's volcano and battled the largest Kau Lana until, at last, it bent to his will. Since then, the two races have lived in peace, working together as dragonriding pairs to nurture and protect their home.

As a gesture of goodwill, Luther invited all the surviving villagers to join him in Rigland's capital. Naturally, he adopted the Kau Lana into the ranks of the Red Dragon Knights as well.

But the children of the wind and waves couldn't thrive so far from the sea. Year after year, their population dwindled, as the dragons rejected their new training and fled to the ruins of their island.

Some say those who sail near Tuatha these days can hear their echoing cries, mourning the home they lost.

Some men go to war for glory. Others for love of battle. Timia joined the war to follow in her father's footsteps, to see his dream of a united Erden fulfilled.

When she was but a child, he showered her with tales of the Bergarian royalty. The early tribal kings who shepherded their people through the mountains. The first true emperor, born of the Primordial of Light. They fought with true nobility, liberating the land from the tyrants who would divide it.

Their legends planted the seeds of courage in her heart. And when her father fell in battle, those seeds burst into bloom.

RedElfOfficer02.Profile:
Despite her youthful idealism, Timia is no fool. She knows all too well the cost of war. In her military training, her superiors made her memorize the casualties of past battles. They led her unit to rebel villages, forcibly crushed to keep their people under Imperial rule. In every eye, she saw the pain of her father's death, and she came to a resolution.

She could not allow this to continue.

As long as divisions among the people exist, there will be war. As long as there is war, innocent blood will flow. For the sake of lasting peace, the other lands of Erden must fall. And until their people understand that, Timia will do what she must.

Once upon a time, a little girl named Clarice lived with her mother on the streets of a very cold, very cruel city.

Clarice loved her mother dearly, but love could not fill their hungry bellies. Day after day, her mother would lead her around, asking for coin, for shelter, for anything.

No one could give her what she asked, because no one had anything to spare.

Finally, on a night when the wind cut like knives, she abandoned her daughter and never once looked back. What a bad little girl she must have been, for her own mother to leave her to die.

Without light, without care, without love,

YandereMaid02.Profile:
Clarice found her way to the mansion of a lord. For a long, long time, the lord kept her as his servant, but she was so clumsy he sold her away, to a noble couple who needed a handmaiden for their daughter Ludmilla.

Even though she was a terrible maid, Ludmilla showed Clarice great kindness. She let her borrow her books and do her hair, and over time, they became the best of friends.

Until she grew up and didn't want her anymore. Until she tried to run away.

Why would she do that? Weren't they friends? Was she a bad girl again?

Why... why... why why why whywhywhywhywh—
YandereMaid02.Profile_Ascended:
Clarice was a bad girl for a very long time. She hurt her best friend, then learned to hurt others too. A sorcerer gave her great power in exchange for her freedom, a trade she made all too happily. As long as he wouldn't abandon her, she'd never leave his side.

Little did she know, being left alone was not the same as being forgotten.

Though she had grown into a twisted assassin in their time apart, Ludmilla saw the lonely, scared girl inside Clarice. She forgave her for the terrible things she'd done, and released her from the evil binding her heart. For the first time in her life, Clarice was truly free.

A happy ending had found her after all.

Not even the Church can explain just how the blood of ninety-nine innocent girls revives the world, but somehow it does, every century since the dawn of history. 

Truthfully, Saya only cared about the Requiem because some old composer chose to turn it into a ballet. Her teacher cast her as the Goddess's Grace, the lead, hoping to make her a star. 

In a way, she did. Soon after the performance, the whole world knew her name. But not for the reasons Saya had hoped.

SchoolGirlWarrior02.Profile:
It happened so fast. Her car dove off the bridge and crashed into the water below, submerging her, drowning her. It should have been her end, a rising star snuffed out by tragedy. For better or for worse, it wasn't. 

Deep beneath the river, Saya escaped the wreckage and rose light as air, buoyed by the burning power inside her. Something would not allow her to die. Not yet. Not before she'd served her purpose. 

As she soon learned, the Vessels of the Goddess cannot die before the Requiem. The shard of divinity inside her, the Goddess's Grace she'd shown through her dance, had protected her from death. 

But at what cost?
SchoolGirlWarrior02.Profile_Ascended: In a way, being a Vessel and being an etoile aren't so different. They both sacrifice their freedom for a greater purpose, though dancers do so at least a little by choice. As a ballerina, Saya shut herself away, too busy dancing to bother with a normal life. She convinced herself hard work meant misery. She accepted that a person could either choose greatness or happiness, never both. Now, as a Vessel, she can live how she chooses. She can make friends, and eat sweets, and study the katana, even if swordwork goes against her Gift. There's nothing to prove anymore, not with the Requiem coming. And even though that should scare her, Saya's never felt so free.

OniSchoolGirl01.Profile:
The Church keeps records of the order they find the Vessels for the Requiem. In truth, it doesn't matter all that much. Some Vessels found early have always been weak, while a few Vessels found late have proven themselves to be contenders. 

Still, everyone knows Hibiki Himeno was the very first Vessel found. Even worse, no one knows her Gift. 

Speculation floats around, of course. The Goddess's Bloodthirst would explain her ferocity in battle. Wit would explain her ability to ace tests without studying. Some have suggested she's the Goddess's Luck, because who else could get away with half of what she does? 

But some say they saw her shadow shortly before they themselves awoke as Vessels. And no one can explain that.

Never trust a smiling devil.
She smiles because she knows she's won.

OniSchoolGirl02.Profile:
In the past, Vessels have never managed to turn eighteen. As soon as the hundredth one is found, the Requiem begins soon after, and the world enjoys another century of peace. This has always happened within eighteen years, but so far it's been almost twenty, posing the school a unique problem: graduates who were never meant to graduate. 

Some, like Nanami and Reina, proved skilled enough to become staff at the school. Others remain in a small village nearby, working odd jobs and pretending they've escaped their death sentence. 

Hibiki, on the other hand? She's only a second year, despite being eighteen, and she likes it just fine. It's not like she has to worry about the future, after all.
OniSchoolGirl02.Profile_Ascended:
What makes Hibiki an oni? Vessels who have traits of other species usually share their characteristics, so what is it that made those horns sprout out of her head? 

Most would say it's cruelty. The demon's horns give away her sadistic heart and cruel nature. They whisper about her vicious tactics in combat and defer to her every whim, scared of what she might do otherwise. 

She uses their fear, of course, because fear can get her what she wants. But those who've known her since the beginning can attest that she's never hurt anyone who didn't deserve it.

BunnySamurai01.Profile:
Lightning Hare Nanami, Shinano Academy graduate and interim professor of combat. Vessel of the Goddess's Speed. 

That's how the other students know her, at least. To tell the truth, it weirds her out to think of herself as a professor. She'd always been a wild kid, right from the day they brought her to the school, and she can't say teaching high school girls how to beat each other up was her lifelong dream. But it hasn't been working out too badly...so far, at least. 

Everyone in the school knows her gift. With sword strikes so swift they're barely visible, there was never any hiding it. Some would say that puts her at a disadvantage. Nanami says anyone who wants to take her on is more than welcome to try.

BunnySamurai02.Name: Nanami
BunnySamurai02.Profile: Most of Nanami's students think her ears gave her away as a Vessel. And they're not totally wrong: a little girl with bunny ears will naturally draw more Church attention than her normal classmates. But even non-Vessels can gain an animal's ears or tail, if the Goddess chooses to bless them with it. No. Five-year-old Nanami saw a car hurtling towards a puppy in the road and dove out to save it. In a matter of seconds, she had not only reached the puppy and picked it up; she'd shot across the street, clear into the next neighborhood, too panicked to stop running. They found her downtown a day later, still holding the puppy. That was when the Church knew she was truly special.

DarkRizetteChristmas01.Profile:
Rizette always enjoyed helping out around the house. As trivial as that memory seems now, she holds it close to her heart. There was a time she couldn't remember anything of herself. Not her past, not her friends, nothing beyond Orcanix's latest orders. Sometimes, she's afraid she'll slip back into that horrific void.

So she remembers how it felt to tidy up her family's meager home. How her heart raced as she nursed Finn back to health. Perhaps she wasn't heroic before her fall, but she refuses to think those little acts of kindness meant nothing.

Keeping her loved ones safe and happy was the only life she ever wanted.

In the depths of winter, don't forget:
warm days will dawn once more.

DarkRizetteChristmas02.Name: Endless Rizette
DarkRizetteChristmas02.Profile:
She didn't love Finn as soon as she saw him. That would be too much like a fairy tale. When he arrived beaten and broken from the attack on his village, Rizette nursed him the same way she would any new refugee. They called her the Angel of the Outer City precisely because she never turned anyone away.

Still, she couldn't deny the kinship between them, both teenagers ripped from their families by the undead. When he had no place to go, it was only natural she invite him to live with her and her brother. How could she have known where it would lead?

How could she have known their growing love would lead to ruin?
DarkRizetteChristmas02.Profile_Ascended:
They went to fight Orcanix on the darkest night of the year, the bitter midwinter solstice prophesied by Callen and the Sages. Despite the biting cold, Rizette had always loved the holiday. It brought everyone she loved together, snug and cozy around a blazing fire. She thought she'd love it even more when it became the day they freed their people.

Even now, after everything she went through, she can't bring herself to hate wintertime. When the snow falls soft on the ground and the world stands still, she doesn't think of the night she lost everything. She doesn't think of the war, or the long path ahead of them towards peace.

She closes her eyes, remembers that all is well, and reaches for the love that keeps her warm.

DarkAstridNewYear01.Name: Endless Astrid
DarkAstridNewYear01.Profile:
Come one, come all, to toast the dying year.

Astrid has prepared a feast for all of winter's wanderers. Her hearth burns warm and her table seats hundreds. As soon as night falls, she opens her gates and welcomes monster and innocent alike. She has been both. She knows that life flies by, no matter who you are, no matter what you've done. It is what separates the mortals from the gods.

Few view death as a celebration. But then, few can see it through Astrid's eyes.

Mortality, the chance to grow and change, is the greatest gift a soul can be given.
DarkAstridNewYear01.GachaIntro:
She toasts the old year as it dies.
For without death, what can be born anew?

DarkAstridNewYear02.Name: Endless Astrid
DarkAstridNewYear02.Profile:
There was a time she couldn't conceive of joy. Even now, the feeling seems a stranger to her, a guest she invited without truly knowing. Orcanix once convinced her revenge would be her joy, but even deep in the Goddess's thrall, she knew that was a lie.

Astrid never delighted in destruction. Looking back, she wonders how she managed to build the Rebellion when her heart was so black with misery. She didn't want to hurt Ludmilla. She didn't hate Last Bastion, or its Vanguard soldiers. She just wanted to know why.

What had she done to make her friend hate her so much?
DarkAstridNewYear02.Profile_Ascended:
Reconciliation. Surely such a thing is impossible. What friendship can survive two heinous betrayals? Astrid was sure she would one day meet Ludmilla in hell, and they could finish whatever was left of their fight there.

Instead, her soul was found and forgiven. A lifetime of guilt disappeared from her shoulders all at once, and suddenly, she was pure. She couldn't say she deserved it, after everything she'd done, but when happiness finally came to her again, she welcomed it with open arms.

Mortals fear death as an unforgiving end; that is their eternal folly. Astrid knows now: death is but the start of something new.

Even as the world crumbles, nothing draws a crowd quite as big as Mirai's.  

It only makes sense that people line up in droves to see a Vessel in person. Never mind the ugly business of the Requiem. Mirai's voice is that of the Goddess, and it's said that all who hear it are blessed.  

Indeed, reports of civil disturbance plummet in the wake of her concerts. Everyone seems just a little happier. Nothing actually changes for the people, of course. A happy song can't end a famine or turn back a flood. But it can make them forget for a time. 

It's her duty to make them forget.

I'll walk with head held high.

I've seen too many rainbows
to fear a stormy sky."

CatIdolGirl02.Profile:
It's not that Mirai doesn't like being an idol. In fact, singing is the greatest joy she has in life. She sang long before she was put on stage. She thought, in her early days at the academy, that if she worked hard enough, they would let her leave and travel the world. 

She thought correctly. At ten years old, the Church began training her for the demanding lifestyle of an idol. She didn't mind the rigor, nor the invasion of her privacy. After all, her life was never really hers anyway. 

Sometimes she wishes she could sing as herself, without using the Goddess's voice. Just once, to see if the people still love her. 

She likes to think they would.
CatIdolGirl02.Profile_Ascended:
A voice is an instrument. It puts thoughts into words, nothing more. It does not think for itself, and certainly doesn't have its own will. 

That was her first lesson as an idol. She came in with a juvenile scrapbook of song ideas, only to be told she would never sing them. The ones she had written for her were made by true artists, she was told. She couldn't expect to ever match them. 

Mirai understands, in a way. But she can't stop scribbling down poems, or plucking out the melodies she hears on the wind. They might be the work of an amateur, but they are hers. 

And she hopes one of them can live on once she's gone.

DarkCatFighter01.Profile:
Kana Narukami and her little sister Mirai were born with cat ears and a tail, in a world that was mostly human. 

Their parents took this as a sign of good fortune. Only those especially close to the Goddess took on the traits of an animal. Both sisters shared a cat's grace, its speed, as well as its knack for survival. Every time their poor family pulled through misfortune, their mother credited it to her daughters' blessings from the Goddess. 

One day, that blessing revealed itself as the curse it truly was. 

If she'd known Mirai's voice was that of the Goddess herself, Kana would never let her sing at all.

DarkCatFighter02.Profile:
Men in black suits snatched Mirai off the street one morning as she sang for pennies from strangers. They told Kana they were from the Church, and thanked her for keeping a Vessel safe for so long. When Kana sank her teeth into the men taking her sister away, they knocked her out and left her there for Fate to do what it would. 

After a few hours, she woke up and did what any cat would do. She sought out food and shelter. She stayed in the shadows. She wore a mask to hide her horrid pain. 

She adapted. She survived, because she knew it was the only way she would ever get her sister back. 

And at long last, she thinks she's found a way.

AntaresModern01.Name: Antares
AntaresModern01.Profile:
Antares has always been your average girl. 

Her grades are good enough not to disappoint, but she's far from the top of the class. She's pretty in a cute kind of way, but she doesn't turn heads. She's well-liked among her classmates, but not truly popular. 

She blends in so well that at times, she's afraid she'll disappear. 

But jealousy doesn't come naturally to her, and she can never stay mopey for longer than a day or two. Whenever she starts to feel down, she just looks around for what she loves. 

Even in a dying world, she finds things that make her smile. And even if she doesn't realize it, that is a remarkable gift.
AntaresModern01.GachaIntro:
With a heart of hope, she reaches for her sword, 
and a bolt of lightning splits the darkness.

AntaresModern02.Name: Antares
AntaresModern02.Profile:
The thing about discovering your destiny is that you're never truly ready. Everyone's life is average until the moment it isn't -- and none have learned this better than Antares. 

She doesn't know if the Goddess influences fate itself, or if she's just very talented at stringing together coincidences, but as it would happen, her path crossed Mirai Narukami's totally by accident. By meeting her, she discovered the sinister plot of a foreign god looking to brainwash the world. 

And by discovering that plot, she found the power that slept inside her all along. The Goddess's Hope. 

As timid and unsure as she is, only she can save the world.
AntaresModern02.Profile_Ascended:
There have been dozens of recorded Requiems, stretching back to the beginning of human history. Though they started off as earth-shattering wars between demigods, the establishment of the Goddess's Church helped bring the Vessels under a greater authority.  

For the last thousand years, the names and Gifts of each girl have been recorded, to ensure they are honored after their deaths. The specific Gifts the Goddess passes down vary with each cycle, but most make frequent returns, sometimes performing important deeds before passing on.  

Interestingly, Antares's gift has never once appeared. Perhaps that is why the Church has yet to track her down. They have never once looked in a Vessel's eyes and seen a glimmer of hope.

MechaSister01.Profile:
In another world, Luther von Draclow inherited the Red Dragon Knights from a long line of ancestors. But in this world, the world of the Requiem, he founded the military order himself.

A brilliant man, he married an equally brilliant woman to carry on his legacy. His first daughter, Astrid, lived up to his every expectation, and he believed her future siblings could one day surpass her.

But his vision was not to be. His wife passed away giving birth to his second daughter, who he would later name Anastasia.

In every other world, she perished with her mother. Only the technology of Pandora's world gave her the means to fight her Fate. To live.

MechaSister02.Name: Anya
MechaSister02.Profile:
Luther created the Ex Machina weapon alongside the Red Dragon Institute. Using a cloud of invisible nanomachines, an Ex Machina wielder could gain powers rivaling even those of the Goddess's Vessels. But this wasn't enough to satisfy him.

Little Anya's brain, kept in a coma while her body underwent medical treatment, proved to be more malleable than any other Luther had ever seen. He risked her life to mold it into a living quantum computer, capable of recording and even manipulating the forces of Fate.

Anya never knew exactly what her father was doing to her with all the surgeries she underwent. She only knew that if she kept surviving, she would meet her beloved sister Astrid.
MechaSister02.Profile_Ascended:
Anya has almost died more times than she can count. She knows her body is fragile, held together only by her father's medical treatments. She knows her brain holds a special Ex Machina, a cutting edge prototype that puts her into a coma if she pushes it too far.

But she'll only meet her sister if she keeps on surviving.

It was lonely growing up in that hospital. She made friends of the shields she built, and the little drones she could summon with her power. But they couldn't pat her head or give her a hug. They couldn't be her family.

Only Astrid can. And she's out there somewhere, waiting for her.

DeadlyNurse01.Name: Reina
DeadlyNurse01.Profile:
Reina Fujiwara, third child of the Akise Fujiwara family, was never meant to amount to much. Her two older brothers were heir and spare to the Fujiwara real estate empire. Her parents believed she would stand quietly in their family photos, enjoy the luxury of their wealth, and one day marry some celebrity or prince to secure them political power.

They never once thought, not until the day the Church took her away, that they had given birth to a piece of the Goddess herself.

Reina became the Tenth Vessel of Pandora at age seven, bearing the Gift of the Goddess's Wisdom. And she is happier at Shinano Academy than she ever was at home.

DeadlyNurse02.Profile:
Knowing her Gift, no one was surprised when Reina quickly surpassed her classmates in every academic subject. They promoted her from second grade to sixth within three months at the Academy, then sent her directly into high school a year after that. Nothing seemed to challenge the sharp little girl, who burned through every exam with masterful finesse.

Soon, Reina found herself studying on her own, taken out of the other girls' classes entirely. This was in part to spare them the pain of being so thoroughly bested, but that was not the only reason.

The teachers had noticed that tears, fights, and chaos followed wherever Reina went. For everyone's sake, it was better to keep her alone.
DeadlyNurse02.Profile_Ascended:
It surprises some to find out, but the Goddess's Wisdom and the Goddess's Intelligence are not the same Gift. Another Vessel in her class held the Goddess's Intelligence, in fact. She was a bright-eyed thing, reading years above her grade level, always studying and trying her best.

Reina outstripped her test scores every time they competed.

Intelligence comes from inborn talent and books. Wisdom comes from experience, and a Goddess has had millennia of that to pass on. It is why Reina chose to become a doctor, when nothing about her nature embraces healing.

A doctor sees people at their lowest. Even more than a warrior, a healer holds life in her hands. Among those desperate to escape death, nothing gives her more power than that.

ReiSwimsuit02.Profile: The reddish light of the setting sun, the scent of flowers and trees, and her mother's laugh. This is Rei's happiest memory, from when her father still watched over Kisenkyo. To her, an outsider, her mother was her only friend. With her mother a thousand years dead and gone, Rei wondered if she would ever laugh like that again.

"Finn, won't you bathe with me?"
"S-sorry, what?"
"I'm told that serious discussions should be had while baring all to one another."
"But—"

"Oh, really?"
"What a shame that is, Sir Finn."
"N-Nagi!"
"..."
"E-Elmina?"
"So nice to see you two getting along..."

RizetteYoung02.Profile:
When Rizette awakens, the sweet smell of pear pie fills the room. Half-asleep, she goes to the table, where her grandmother greets her with a smile. Theo arrives, still yawning, and the three of them start their day.
"Mm, so good!"
"Aah, hot!"
"Haha. Slow down, dear!"
"You're gonna burn your tongue again, Sis!"
She thought those days would last forever.

She's repeated that day over and over, hoping that things could be different, but in the end, the past cannot be changed. Even so, her grandmother lives on within her, supporting her every day. Nothing in the world can change that, either.

In a land far to the East, there lives an oni. This oni, however, is a slayer of her fellows.
She prays to no gods, performs no rituals. Yet when battle looms, she is the first to ready her blade. She is the Scarlet Oni, the one who strikes at her fellows' throats without mercy.

OniSchoolSamurai02.Profile:
Hotter, hotter, hotter. Blood seeks, craves blood. The fire within her rages outward, onward. It burns those her crimson gaze passes over. In her nightclothes, she can even hear it— the pounding rush of her heart pumping her burning blood.
Oni blood, irresistibly pulling her along a path she has no choice but to walk.
"Your blood's red, same as mine..."

Rough speech, and an utterly relaxed posture, with plenty of half-eaten food around to top it off. A vision from another possible world, perhaps. A world with no war between humans and oni. The happy laughter of the oni maiden echoes, faintly, from distant memories.

Inside the castle, the party continues, with food, chatter, and the clink of glasses. But Ludmilla finds herself outside, alone, her cheeks and nose reddened by the cold. A clinging dress, uncomfortable high heels... "What am I doing in these? They don't suit me at all..." Her sigh is white mist in the frozen night.
"That's not true at all, Miss." Hearing a soft voice and footsteps behind her, she turns.

to try it on, but it's... embarrassing..."

Though she seems so cheerful and carefree when on stage, she's the hardest working member of the group, always staying in the rehearsal room long after the others have gone home. She stumbled and fell, and just stayed down, unable to understand how she could make such a blunder at the very last moment. And just like that, she remembered that she wasn't alone, that they were in this together. Her bright smile back in place, she joined her friends to finish up the last dance of that night.

That was the routine for the original Gawain, the Knight of the Sun. The current one still draws her sword when the sun is the furthest from the moon, she as well a match for a thousand-man army.

—Your king has summoned you.
No matter how cruel the curse you must bear,
you are needed at the Round Table.

CrossSwordKnight02.Profile:
Just like there is no rain that never stops, there is no sun that never sets. However, her—no, any Gawain's—loyalty towards their king will never wane, no matter how different each new bearer of the name is. In that sense, she is Gawain through and through.
But just like there is no sun that never sets, there can be no moon that never rises.

The people of Camelot love the sun. "Because it is what makes our finest knight the finest," they always say. That is, however, not entirely true—what they really love is Gawain's warm nature. Kinder and more considerate than anyone, she is just like their own sun—thus, they would call her "the Knight of the Sun" even if the source of her power lay elsewhere.
Because in the heart of the current Gawain lives the warmth of a bright, clear day.

Gifted with exceptional power as she was, she seemed to only destroy everything she touched, and so she became an outcast. She made countless offerings, one after another, all created by herself, from herself. But after the ritual was performed a thousand times, the attempts stopped, and she started being known as someone completely different—the one hiding behind a myriad of masks.

Like any newborn child, she had no sense of good and evil, as susceptible to the former as she was to the latter. Likewise, like any newborn child, there was only one thing she sought—and so, she took the scientist who created her to be her mother.

OssiaDark02.Name: Ossia
OssiaDark02.Profile:
Her creator could not decide if she should be treated as a weapon or as a person until the very end. However, after Ossia died, she was resurrected by a man eternally devoted to forging arms. A woman made to be a weapon and a man only interested in weapons, both equally twisted—perhaps their paths were destined to cross.
"Who does not work shall not eat," he would always say, so she started helping with gathering materials for his creations, learning all about the world, life, and the give-and-take of trade in the process. Therefore, if there is anyone that can be called her father, surely—
"I think I've heard quite enough of these conjectures, thank you very much."
OssiaDark02.Profile_Ascended:
She did not rush out into the world right after the smith took her in. First, she used the uncontrolled, devastating power she was given in her first life, and the immortality that came with her second one, to repeat the cycle of self-destruction and rebirth over and over again. Throughout that time, she kept wondering if her mother's love for her was genuine or not, and if what she herself felt towards her mother was love or hate.
(Later, she came to the conclusion that it would be much better if feelings were easily classified as loss or gain, business-like and manageable.)
Answers did not come to her though, not even after she finally got her power under control. Therefore, she set out to create an even more advanced being than herself—eager to know how she would feel towards a "child" of her own.

However, even with its support, at times it still feels like the burden of responsibility is about to crush her—no matter how imposing she looks, in the end she's still a young girl. A girl that longed to be a hero who helps the weak, until she actually became one.
Sometimes even a hero needs a helping hand.

CinderellaRegular02.Profile: Orphaned as a small child, she grew up in a poor household, under the eye of her wicked stepmother. She was forced to do everything around the house all by herself, and wasn't allowed to go out to play. The townsfolk always frowned at the dirty rags she wore, always gave her pointed looks. She was never loved by anyone—aside from one person.

The thing she was eventually overcome by was not a spell or a curse, but the same lung disease that took her father. Her body shaken by violent coughs, her throat burning, her eyes blurry, she felt that the dream she once told her father about—her dream to go to the ball at the castle—was slipping right through her fingers.
That is when a small hand knocked on her door.

She was never allowed to play with her peers, and didn't have a single friend. She saw herself as something akin to a doll rather than a human, and in an act of self-torment she made dolls in her free time. However, they were all taken from her too.
She was alway all alone—that is, until a certain girl came into her life.

With her forbidden power, she made the flow of time in the kingdom stop for long, long years—until the entire country was covered with thorns. It was better this way. This way, she could be with her friend forever and ever and—
However, after a while, little rips started showing in the fabric of her dreamscape, and little by little the cogs of reality that she'd halted started to stir. Just as she was about to lose all hope, a girl appeared in front of her—a shadowy being roaming around the world of dreams.

It was called "a motorcycle," they told her. Once she got on, the city didn't seem so threatening anymore, and she found out just how addictive speed can be.

DarkRizetteSwimsuit02.Profile:
After losing so much, she finally gained something—a new life. She decided to spend it atoning for her sins. Having parted ways with the other Finn, she started surveying the city for any remaining undead, to prevent this world from ending up the way her own had.
He thinks she should stop blaming herself.
He thinks she should enjoy herself more. After all, life shouldn't be lived for the past, but for the present and the future.
Her co-workers in this new world seem to understand that, though, so he thinks she should be all right, in the end.
"Yo, Endless! Let's hit the pool next!"
DarkRizetteSwimsuit02.Profile_Ascended: After bidding farewell to the ones she held dear, she was assigned duty as the Primordial of Death's Avatar: collecting souls that didn't die properly. She was to lead the undead, ghosts, all those who couldn't move on due to the unnatural circumstances of their death, towards the proper end. It made her wonder: can she, a person reborn with undead powers, live properly? Can she ever meet a proper death? Who has she become? The answers will come with time. She doesn't know it yet, but after she defeated the Fullmetal Knight and countless other evildoers that prowl the city's streets every night, after she saved numerous lives time and time again, people started calling her "the Undead Savior of Shinjuku".

At one point, his path crossed with a young woman from a nearby town, and so he was blessed with a daughter.

She was nothing like her mild-tempered parents, and found the peace that had settled over the area boring. The conflict she desired came unexpectedly, brought about by a local commoner's betrayal—oni ringleaders were let into the town, and within one night the streets filled up with corpses. Nobunaga's father fell trying to defend the townsfolk, and her mother perished protecting her daughter from the attackers.
And so, from that day on, Nobunaga became a demon herself—a fierce spirit of revenge.

RoundTableKnightBride02.Profile:
When the Knights of the Round Table were asked to choose one member to model a wedding dress, the king passed the task on to Gawain, and Gawain—to Lancelot. "This kind of thing is not exactly what I'm into..." she protested, but when she tried to find someone else to do it, all the other knights were mysteriously absent.
When Gawain, haunted by her guilty conscience, went to the photoshoot venue later, she found Lancelot entangled in the ribbons decorating the place, with a deep flush on her face.
RoundTableKnightBride02.Profile_Ascended:
After Gawain reprimanded Lancelot for not taking the task seriously and left, the king herself appeared at the venue to check on her subordinate's progress.
"Huff, huff... Ah, Your Majesty. Um, I got tangled in these decorative chains somehow... Nghh! Could you perhaps help me...?" Lancelot implored, but the king, well aware and understanding of her preferences, just closed the door silently.
Though it might not appear so from the way she looks now, left alone and breathless in the wedding hall, for anyone who knows her it is clear that the upright and honest Lancelot, always ready to meet any challenges life throws her way, would surely make a wonderful bride.

KaguyahimeRegular02.Name: Kaguya
KaguyahimeRegular02.Profile:
Her body contained a deadly toxin developed in order to wipe out all intelligent life on Erden, and she was created with the sole purpose of delivering it to its target. Her beauty was supposed to captivate as many human men as possible, and they in turn were supposed to become the next carriers of the toxin.
However, the plan failed. Kaguya didn't want anyone on Erden to get hurt, so she decided to prevent that by avoiding human contact altogether.
KaguyahimeRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
And so, out of the kindness of her heart, she chose to distance herself from everybody. Life of solitude didn't mean peace of mind, though—she spent countless sleepless nights tormented by loneliness, desperately trying not to cry or scream.
The person who found her right after she had landed on Erden gave her her name—Kaguya, meaning, "may your path shine bright." May you never know darkness or loneliness again.
Perhaps that wish was the reason why years later fate brought her together with a person capable of setting her free.

I know everything there is to know about you
Even things you don't realize yourself...

Gacha:

that's me.

There is nothing my Eye cannot observe.
Not your past, not your future either...
You'd do well to remember you can't hide anything from me.

I knew you were going to show up.
Precisely here, precisely now.
Well then, I will follow you wherever you go. I hope you can keep me entertained.

The Eye of All Laws... One that can see anything and everything...
At first, I got a little intoxicated with its power.
Yes, I have some regrets about that time...

The tea is ready, and we have madeleines to go with it. I personally picked the best of the best!
I do hope they are to your liking...
Oh, right, shall I...feed them to you?

I think Loki was the good one, after all.
Maybe she has changed...
Or maybe I have...
The passage of time can be brutal sometimes...
Idle:
Hm? Where is everyone...
A-Are they ignoring me!?
No... Perhaps they just can't see me...?
Heeeey! I am heeere!

OdinRegular02.Name: Odin
OdinRegular02.Profile:
She is always calm, collected, and magnanimous. Even during Ragnarok, the war that almost destroyed this world long years ago, she would never miss her afternoon tea time.
After the war came to an end, she solemnly handed out forgiveness to those who deserved it, and eternal punishment to those who did not. And sometimes, she would even let them see her smile.
OdinRegular02.Profile_Ascended: She tirelessly pursued all knowledge she had yet to know, every sight she had yet to see. Endlessly watched every conceivable place, time period, dimension. And after millenia of observing all possible phenomena and rules, she finally felt it—the feeling she's been unconsciously denying this whole time, one that has actually been consuming her all along.

Sniff... Astri... Where are you...

CleopatraRegular01.Name: Cleopatra
CleopatraRegular01.Profile:
Once, she had it all.
She was born in the Kingdom of Kemet, a land favored by the great river, blessed with rich, black soil—just like she was blessed with an abundance of talents. She didn't let herself rely solely on her gifts, though, but used them to gain as much knowledge as possible. Unmatched in skill, she was more than qualified to take on any number of duties. However, there was only one role she had her eyes on...
CleopatraRegular01.GachaIntro:
Lies hiding behind masks,
betrayal shrouded in schemes—
all for the sake of her beloved country

Oh my, so you're a hero too?

Let's leave it at that for now, shall we?

That queen of Orugeia...

No, once a country has two rulers, it's already all over, isn't it.
Idle:
My darling white lily...
Someone as steeped in deceit and blood as I am shouldn't even think of touching one as pure as you. I'll be glad just to be allowed to stay by your side.

CleopatraRegular02.Name: Cleopatra
CleopatraRegular02.Profile:
Once, she lost all she had.
She was too brilliant for her own good. Those she devoted her life to turned their backs on her, those she thought loyal suddenly sang a different tune—and they crushed her love under their feet. Seeking death, she turned to venom, but what she ended up embracing was deadlier than any toxin—lethal enough, in fact, to leave death behind and receive eternity. And it was with venom that she then purged her beloved, poisoned country.
CleopatraRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
Once, she offered up all she had left.
"Let me dedicate all my talents to you. Utilize all my knowledge to serve you. No one else is worthy of my devotion, my trust... If that's not love, then what is it?
My one and only, my beloved—my country."
After all, she's only ever had eyes for one role—that of a queen. And she has the whole eternity to perform it.

GilgameshRegular01.Name: Gilgamesh
GilgameshRegular01.FullName: Gilgamesh - Lion Queen of the Desert
GilgameshRegular01.Profile:
There once was a girl from the slums. Everything she had had been taken from her—her parents, her home, all her possessions. Until one day, she was finally given something; a gift quite unexpected and unique—the crown.
She could have stopped at being a figurehead. It would have been enough to provide her with everything she'd always lacked, and more. But she chose to become a genuine queen instead.
GilgameshRegular01.GachaIntro:
I'll show you what it means to be a queen—
The Almighty Queen!

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:
400% damage to 1 enemy if the user is burning. Otherwise, damage to 1 enemy and the user is then granted the Burn status effect. This will overwrite other status effects on the user. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.

If the user's current HP is at 50% or less, exchanges the user's current HP with the amount of HP the user has currently lost.

Gacha:
I am Gilgamesh, Queen of Orugeia.
How insolent of you to summon the mightiest warrior in the country with no warning or explanation!

Ha! You're a hero, you say? I see. What are the odds...
Show me what you're worth, then! That's an order!
Login:
You're late.
There's a whole pile of work waiting for you over there. Get to it.
What do you mean, "what's the rush?" You said you'd take me out for a break later, didn't you?
Tap:
Eeek!
...Forget I made that sound. Right now! That's an order!
Anyone would be surprised if you poked them out of nowhere... And anyway, what gave you the idea that you are allowed to touch the queen!

...Just because you've asked permission now doesn't mean you can just keep poking me, you know?
Don't worry, I'm here. The real me.
Let this necklace be the proof.

Cleopatra... Queen of Kemet.
I've had countless servants, but not a single one as brilliant as you.
To think what we could've achieved together... Ha, as if.
Idle:
"There was no mountain too high, no sea too vast—if someone needed help, the hero would go to any length to lend a hand."
That's one of the stories I heard as a child...and the kind of person I've always admired. A person like you.

GilgameshRegular02.Name: Gilgamesh
GilgameshRegular02.FullName: Gilgamesh - Lion Queen of the Desert
GilgameshRegular02.Profile:
And so fortune smiled on the girl, and she inherited the throne. But the throne was just a vessel for greatness. The effort made to fill it, the time spent tirelessly pushing forward in order to be recognized as a true queen—that was all her.
Soon enough, her domain echoed with voices praising her. But she didn't rest on her laurels. She kept on learning and improving herself, all to see the ones who had recognized her as their queen smile.
GilgameshRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
Why did she become the queen in the first place?
It was because of the stories she heard after she managed to escape the kill-or-be-killed reality of the slums—stories of heroes who always helped those in need. For a long time, they were the only bright spots in her dark life, like a cluster of shining stars no one could steal from her. But she was pragmatic, so she knew stars were miles and miles away. Unreachable.
And then she heard about the claim she had to the throne, and in that moment she immediately knew that it was her chance to finally aim for the starry sky.

RizetteBride01.Name: Rizette
RizetteBride01.Profile:
The sunlight pouring into the chapel makes all the whites even brighter as Rizette looks up at her intended, slightly taller than her even though she's wearing high heels. She can feel everyone gently watching over her—her beloved little brother who walked her down the aisle, her companions who fought by her side on countless battlefields...
She hears the big question, "Do you?" and the answer is so obvious, has been for ages, really. And as the bells start ringing, she thinks to herself that it all feels like a dream.
RizetteBride01.GachaIntro:
Wedding bells are ringing,
erasing the scars of war with their clear voice

RizetteBride02.Name: Rizette
RizetteBride02.Profile: She doesn't notice it really is a dream, not until an unexpected visitor points it out—another Rizette, dressed in black, visibly angry at the one who dreamed up this happy world. "It's not fair that only you get to have this," that Rizette says. But she drives away all the evil things lurking around nevertheless. Perplexed, Rizette in white can't help but ask, "Have you come to destroy my dream, or to protect it?"
RizetteBride02.Profile_Ascended:
"I came to interrupt this dream. But I won't let anyone else touch it," Rizette in black answers. She knows how precious this fantasy is better than anyone else—she's learned the hard way that being able to be by your loved one's side is the greatest of miracles. And so, she tries giving the other Rizette a push in the right direction.
"Go, make this dream come true in the real world."

GokuDark01.FullName: Dark Sun Wukong - The Great Menace, Hell's Equal

Heralded by a roar of laughter, a golden-haired girl appears in the moonlight. She holds Ruyi Bang in her hand and wears Jinguer on her head...but she is not Sun Wukong. She is a different troublemaker, born from within Wukong. Her name is Vajra.
For you see, a girl with a dangerous mix of Yin and Yang personalities was once abandoned on Mount Huaguo...
GokuDark01.GachaIntro:
Just like Sun Wukong, and not like her at all—
Brace yourself, here she comes!

Hey, Wukong! Sanzang called for you. She looked mad.

GokuDark02.Name: Dark Sun Wukong
GokuDark02.FullName: Dark Sun Wukong - The Great Menace, Hell's Equal
GokuDark02.Profile:
When the Monkey God took Wukong in, he was well aware of the two personalities dwelling in her. And so, he didn't only raise one of them, he raised both.
When Vajra finally emerged, she could wield Ruyi Bang, fly Nimbus, and use Monkey God's techniques just as well as Wukong could—because she trained just as hard, though hidden the whole time.
GokuDark02.Profile_Ascended:
Born of Yin energy, Vajra is far more selfish than Wukong, and tries to make anyone she takes a liking to her servant. Still, just because she is Yin-aligned doesn't mean she is evil. She would never turn her back on those who are lonely or left behind, and cares for all her "servants" more than any other "master."
It seems that when the Monkey God decided to share one of the many names he is known under, Vajrang Bali, with her, he also gifted her with some of his best qualities.

OtohimeRegular01.FullName: Otohime - Ruler of the Dragon Palace
OtohimeRegular01.Profile:
The young lady of the Dragon Palace leads her people as skilfully as she can lead their traditional dance. You would be ill-advised to praise her for accomplishing so much at such a young age, though—unless you want to become the next target of her exceptionally sharp tongue.
Because you see, she despises nothing more than being considered a child.

Welcome to my domain—
the abyssal depths where dreams are born

OtohimeRegular02.Name: Otohime
OtohimeRegular02.FullName: Otohime - Ruler of the Dragon Palace
OtohimeRegular02.Profile:
She is sharp in performing her duties as well, always making sure the residents of her domain are safe and provided with sufficient amount of dream pieces to sustain themselves. However, when faced with unforeseen situations, she tends to get overwhelmed and freeze up.
No matter how much she pushes herself to act mature, she's still a child in some respects—but her subjects love that side of her too.
OtohimeRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
Why did she assume such a responsible role at her age in the first place? Because she wanted to earn her mother and father's recognition. Her subordinates know that all too well, just like they know that they cannot replace her parents. All they can do is stay by her side and watch out for any danger.
What they don't realize is that it's thanks to them that Otohime can be the proud ruler she is today.

CinderellaDark01.Profile:
If Cinderella never met her fairy godmother, if she stayed at the ball past midnight, if she lost her best friend, if, if, if—
She doesn't wait for someone to grant her happiness, she reaches out and takes it for herself. She doesn't bother with promises, she just chooses whichever option looks interesting at the moment.
"And if anyone threatens Talia, I will crush them, no matter who or what they are."
CinderellaDark01.GachaIntro:
From now on, there'll be no mercy—
not for begging, not for tears, not for anything

CinderellaDark02.Profile:
Once she wrapped herself in darkness, she tried to act accordingly. However, despite the fact that on the surface she seemed to have turned sadistic, at heart she was still the same kind girl she'd been before. Even when she was about to take away another person's power, she was courteous enough to explain the risks and get their consent.
The truth is, when she embraced darkness, she was secretly a bit happy that she was going to match her best friend now.
CinderellaDark02.Profile_Ascended:
Cinderella's mother neglected her. She treated her like a servant and didn't spare a single thought even when she fell gravely ill. But Cinderella is different. No matter how tempting the darkness might be, no matter how dirty her hands might get, she would never stoop that low.
Because the only reason she reached for power beyond her own caliber was to save someone dear to her.

The self-proclaimed "future Ruler of Hell" was in fact just a gatekeeper. She was fired, however, and after trying to find her place for a little while, she became a Red Dragon Knight... Well, to be more precise, a Red Dragon Squire.

Oh, and her dog ears? They're fake.

Eeeeek! A dog! A doooooooog!!!
Somebody heeeeeelp!!!

CerberusRegular02.Profile:
After springing into existence, she immediately had two fated encounters: first with a dog—a creature destined to become her arch-nemesis—and then with a boy who came to her rescue.
Convinced that what's scary to her must also be scary to others, she dons dog ears in order to give herself a menacing aura. And as for the boy, she keeps the memory of their meeting safe in her heart.

Haunted by the Pandemonium, natural disasters and numerous wars, Erden has lost countless lives. And so, people clung to hope that their departed loved ones might find peace in the afterlife—one after another, the survivors wished for salvation after death.
Eventually, from the earnestness of their wishes, a new Primordial was born.

LudmillaYukata01.Profile:
In her life, Ludmilla's shared a bond with countless people. A lot of them were other knights—the superiors who taught her ins and outs of being a knight, the subordinates she taught in turn, the comrades she felt at ease with. All these bonds made her stronger, but at the same time...
As a matter of fact, the outfit she's wearing right now was obtained due to a certain bond too.
LudmillaYukata01.GachaIntro:
When people think of beauty,
what shows before their eyes is death

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Earth element units have their Attack increased by 10% and max HP increased by 7%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:
100% damage to 2 enemies. 600% damage instead if the user has survived for 200TU on the battlefield. Heals the user for 100% of total damage dealt. All enemies hit by this attack will become Weakened, this will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on those units.

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.

Grants the Stealth status effect with a Stealth Shield to 1 other ally. Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on that ally. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying.

Immediately give all other allies that are at max HP the next turns by reducing their current TU. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn.

Then heals all allies other than the user for 100% of their max HP, Purifies them (removes negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison), and grants them Recovery Mist for 200TU. A unit with Recovery Mist will heal for 5% of their max HP and have a 30% chance to be Purified after every turn. Recovery Mist effects do not stack. Usable once per battle.

Randomly grants each non-burning ally either a Stun Ward, Sleep Ward, or Poison Ward and Purifies them.

If the user's current HP is at 50% or less, exchanges the user's current HP with the amount of HP the user has currently lost.

Weakens all enemies.

Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
This unit has a 20% chance to ignore attacks that would damage exactly 2 targets, plus 20% per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings). Attacks that target All allies will not be ignored. If this unit gains the Stealth status effect, it will not be lost when ignoring attacks in this way.

This unit is a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield for 200TU after entering battle.
10% less damage from attacks by Dark units.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Can use weapon skills of Spears in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
I thought I'd wear this outfit again today, to celebrate our special bond.
Why the coat? Ah, well... I felt kind of uneasy without my uniform.

I heard this kind of clothes can ward you from death and misfortune. It can't hurt to put them on every now and then, don't you think?
Login:
We are greatly honored to have you visiting us. Welcome!
...Hah, I don't think I'm cut out for this.
I asked my friends from the East to teach me their brand of hospitality, but, well...
Tap:
Everything is so vivid and colorful in the living world... I can see why Cerberus came to like it here.

Pearl!? Why are you in my head again!?

Hmm hmm, I see you still wear this outfit sometimes. I'm glad.
Ah, no, I can't stay long.
I just wanted to take another look at the surface...from your point of view.

Cerberus! I didn't know you were visiting.
Any problems on your way here? Have you eaten?
Ah, okay, never mind then.
Listen, I... I'm really sorry for what I did in Hell...
Idle:
I've been blessed with many comrades over the years. I couldn't protect them all, though...
If it's true that bonds don't break even after death, maybe fate lets us meet again in the next life.

LudmillaYukata02.Name: Ludmilla
LudmillaYukata02.FullName: Ludmilla - Red Dragon of the East
LudmillaYukata02.Profile:
Some of the bonds she established were severed, despite her best efforts.
She was a knight and so were they. Protectors of their country, they were no strangers to conflict. She trained them to protect each other too, but still, she couldn't stop their blood from being spilled. 
She thinks of them as she looks outside, wishing that at least the extraordinary snowy landscape before her would stay forever unchanged.
LudmillaYukata02.Profile_Ascended:
Bonds hold special meaning in Eastland. Once forged, they might loosen, but will never break, unless one decides to cut them. Even after death, the ties one's established will carry on into the next life, and the one after that.
And sometimes, old bonds give birth to new ones. Determined not to lose a comrade ever again, Ludmilla devoted herself to training, and soon, one after another, like-minded knights started gathering around her for leadership.

PercivalRegular01.Name: Percival
PercivalRegular01.Profile:
A black castle tower looms over a remote island in the middle of the open sea, marking the place of exile of the disgraced Knights of the Round Table.
Normally, a prison would be rife with foul words and even fouler deeds, but here, there are none. Because from the very beginning, the one keeping this place in order was Percival, a knight recognized for his sense of justice by King Arthur himself.
The current Percival, the third warden of the prison, is just as dedicated to upholding justice, and just as feared by the inmates.
PercivalRegular01.GachaIntro:
"When you think of my power, what do you see?"
—That's what you need to ask your king.

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Light element units have their Attack increased by 15%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription: 100% damage to all enemies. 250% damage instead and stuns each enemy for 100TU if they are dealt damage every second time this skill is activated while on the battlefield. Heals the user for 100% of total damage dealt. This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

The user becomes Enraged, and is granted either a Stun Ward or Sleep Ward at random. Heals all allies for 400% of the user's Attack and Weakens all enemies. This skill becomes locked for 100TU after use.

Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. These effects will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on affected units. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.

Targets 1 enemy. 500% damage to targets that have defeated 1+ units with attacks while on the battlefield, or to any target if the user has defeated 2+ units with attacks while on the battlefield. This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, the effects of Skin passive skills and will ignore any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.

500% damage to 2 enemies, and heals the user for 100% of max HP if damage is dealt. This attack ignores damage reduction effects.

Enemies damaged by this attack will be granted one of the following effects:
- Sleep for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield if they are a Fire or Light unit.
- Mega Poison for 200TU if they are a Storm or Earth unit.
- Stun for 200TU if they are a Water or Dark unit.

Locked for 200TU after the user has entered the battlefield, and locks again after each use. After the first use, unlocks each time the user damages an enemy with a different attack. Sleep and Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. This is not considered a Combo Burst type active skill.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
This unit is not affected by stun effects until its first turn since entering the battlefield.
Heals all allies on the battlefield for 800% of this unit's attack when this unit is defeated by an enemy.

When another non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, this unit gains 50% damage reduction from attacks for 150TU, is healed to max HP and becomes Enraged. Then all other allies gain the Armor status effect and become Enraged. This will overwrite other status effects on those allies. Armor grants 50% damage reduction from the next attack, then Armor is removed. This may not trigger if this unit is defeated or sacrificed at the same time.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
10% less damage from attacks by Water units.
Can use weapon skills of Greataxes in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
I am Percival, Knight of the Round Table. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
I might not be as gifted as some of the other warriors out there, but I will do my best to meet your expectations.

...You won't forget about me, right? Please, promise me you won't. Even if you only remember my name! I just feel like I'm always in the shadow of my comrades...
Login:
Good morning! Today in your schedule: training drills, then an escort mission.
Oh? You think I'm well-organized?
Well, maintaining discipline was very important in my previous job.
Tap:
No one insults me here, no one resents me without a reason... What a wonderful workplace!
What? You say this is normal? No way!

Before I came to work here, I was a prison warden.
Most of the prisoners were manageable, but there was this one problem child...
Just thinking about her makes me feel like I'm about to snap...

Sir Gawain is a gourmet, and Lancelot can withstand any pain... Only I don't have any kind of distinctive trait...
Hm? You say I shouldn't worry about it?
Idle:
Oh... Master's gone?
It must be because I'm so useless. Master has finally had enough of me...
Oh no, this is bad. My self-esteem is plummeting again... Come back, Master!

PercivalRegular02.Name: Percival
PercivalRegular02.Profile: Dedicated to her mission as she was, after spending years under the constant stream of insults from her prisoners, Percival's composure finally snapped. "I'm a Knight of the Round Table, aren't I? And yet I haven't even seen the Round Table once! All I do is sit here and deal with criminals, day in, day out... I'm doing a good job, right? Right!?" "Can someone please praise me...?"
PercivalRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
Spending most of her time in a place where she couldn't ask anyone for praise, she suffered in silence, hoping that one day a special someone would arrive and spoil her rotten.
Once the suitable person, already familiar with her fellow knights, appeared on the island and had a chance to get to know her, he came to the following, inevitable conclusion.
"The Round Table certainly has a lot of unique individuals in its ranks."

MordredRegular01.Name: Mordred
MordredRegular01.FullName: Mordred - Rebel of the Round Table
MordredRegular01.Profile:
The girl is defiant. Her name is listed among the Knights of the Round Table, but she has no intention of serving any ruler. If she ever meets King Arthur again, she will immediately go for the kill.
The girl is unfilial. The first Mordred was her grandfather, but she couldn't care less about the remorse he felt. She only wishes she could have slain him herself.
The girl is a rebel, and she's determined to take on the entire damned world.
MordredRegular01.GachaIntro:
The hatred in your heart will soon devour you.
—That's why you need to kill your king.

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Light element units have their Attack increased by 10% and max HP increased by 7%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:
Immediately give all other allies that are burning the next turns by reducing their current TU. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by any affected units until after they have had the turn. Grants the user Healing Burn for 300TU. This will overwrite other status effects on the user. This skill becomes locked for 200TU after use. This skill cannot be used unless there is at least 1 other burning ally on the battlefield.

A unit with Healing Burn will heal after each turn at the same rate as Burn would deal damage instead of taking damage from Burn. Healing Burn will overwrite other status effects on the user and can replace the Burn status effect, but cannot be replaced by Burn. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. Healing Burn will not be removed by Purify skills.

100% damage to 1 enemy, 400% damage if the user is burning, 600% damage if there are at least 4 units with the burn status effect. The user is granted Healing Burn for 300TU and 1 Charge after damage is dealt.

Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

300% damage to all enemies, plus 100% for each each charge stored by the user (600% max). This attack does not consume charges and ignores the Stealth status effect. The user is granted 1 Charge after damage is dealt. Usable if the user has the Burn status effect or if the user is alone on the battlefield.

The user is granted the Mega Healing Burn status effect for 100TU, and is healed for 100% of max HP. Usable only if the user has stored 3 Charges. Consumes all Charges on the user.

A unit with Mega Healing Burn will heal after each turn at 20 times the rate as Healing Burn. Mega Healing Burn will overwrite other status effects including Healing Burn on the user, cannot be overwritten by Burn, Poison or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Mega Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. A unit with Mega Healing Burn will be granted Healing Burn for 300TU when Mega Healing Burn expires.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated until its next turn. This effect can trigger once each time this unit enters the battlefield. Whenever this unit uses Burning Blood, this Hold Ground+ effect is reset so it can trigger again.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack while burning and survives until after the end of the turn with more than 1 HP, this unit will immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. other stuns targeting the lowest TU target). This is not considered a Counter Skin type effect.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
10% less damage from attacks by Earth units.
Can use weapon skills of Greatswords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
I'm Mordred, Knight of the Round Table... Like I have to introduce myself!
I'll get rid of this name, this title, this blasted curse, everything!
You caught my eye, though. You must be out of luck, hahaha! I almost feel bad for you.
Login:
Why are you so late, huh?
Did you get the stuff I told you to?
What? The last one was sold right in front of you? Hmph.
I hope you like serving as my chair, because that'll be your punishment today.
Tap:
Hey, chairs aren't supposed to talk.
What? Do I want the throne?
Lump me in with my piece of shit grandfather again and I'll stab you.
I'm only interested in my own chair. All the others are gonna get smashed.

Give me blood. Now.
Hey, who said you could stand up? You're a chair. Just keep still.
Haa—chomp.

Percival? Ugh, don't even mention her.
She just won't freaking die, and that girl scout act of hers makes me wanna puke. You'd better not act like her, you hear me?
Idle:
Wha, you're just gonna fall asleep with me on your back?
What is wrong with you? Got a screw loose, like those Round Table morons?
You should be scared of me, like Gareth.

MordredRegular02.Name: Mordred
MordredRegular02.FullName: Mordred - Rebel of the Round Table
MordredRegular02.Profile:
Mordred's curse makes its bearers weak to sunlight. In return, they can gain strength by sucking other people's blood.
Bonds of blood helped keep the Round Table unified over the years. Is it a surprise, then, that the knight inclined to steal blood ended up exiled and forsaken?
MordredRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
Through her window in her white room, a girl looks up at the clear sky, wondering what fun is waiting for her today. She hears her mother calling her, and when she follows the voice downstairs, she sees her beloved family and a delicious meal waiting for her—
Mordred was never allowed to have any of that. Through her window in her dark cell, she glares at the gloomy sky, wondering how to survive another day.
