IbarahimeSwimsuit01.Name: Sleeping Beauty
IbarahimeSwimsuit01.Profile: The new season brings along sleepy warmth—but the earthy smell of plants and the early summer breeze tickling Talia's skin tell her this is not a dream. She hears a voice calling her name, and when she turns around, she sees Cinderella. She calls her best friend back, like she always does, and hurries to her side, relieved to know that the world around her is indeed the real one.
IbarahimeSwimsuit01.GachaIntro:
I don't need everlasting dreams anymore
I just want to fall asleep
and wake up next to you every day

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Water element units have their Attack increased by 15%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription: 50% damage to 1 enemy. 300% damage instead every second time this skill is activated while on the battlefield. 25% chance of granting that enemy the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. If Sleep is applied, it will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect and the effects of Skin passive skills. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies.

Targets all units on the battlefield other than the user. Grants all Fire, Earth and Dark targets the Sleep status effect for 200TU and all Water, Storm and Light targets the Sleep status effect for 50TU. This Sleep will be applied even to targets that have already slept while on the battlefield. This skill becomes locked for 300TU after use.

400% damage to all enemies, 600% instead to all sleeping enemies. Each non-sleeping enemy hit has a 50% chance of being granted the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This attack ignores damage reduction effects. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies.

Usable if there is a sleeping enemy on the battlefield. Allies lose 1 Spirit for each sleeping enemy hit by this attack. This skill becomes locked for 200TU after use if Allies would lose more Spirit than they have in this way. Other effects that would cause Allies to lose Spirit may apply before Spirit lost by this skill.

500% damage to 1 enemy, and exchanges the user's current HP with the amount of HP the user has currently lost. Allies gain Spirit equal to the number of units that are sleeping or have slept while on the battlefield after this attack.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn with more than 1HP, this unit grants a random non-sleeping enemy the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This is not a Skin passive skill.

Allies gain 1 Spirit each time a sleeping unit on the battlefield gets the turn.

This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
10% less damage from attacks by Fire units.
Can use weapon skills of Swords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
Hello.
I don't like busy places very much, but I was told the beach we're going to is a private one, so I thought I might as well try this swimsuit on.
Hehe, you don't need to compliment me. Cinderella already did plenty of that.
I hope my dark self doesn't come out today...but if she does, I trust you'll handle the situation?
Login:
Hello.
It's such a nice day today, I managed to get up really quickly.
You have an errand to run at the seaside? Okay.
Please give me a minute, I'll just go grab my hat.
Tap:
Is something wrong?
Ah, you were worried about my health? Yes, I suppose when compared to Cinderella, I must look somewhat feeble.
It used to be the other way around... I don't mind, though.

I heard the one who gave me my Reverie Power, Okuni, cared about her family very much. I couldn't have achieved what I did without her gift, as cursed as it was... I wish I'd had a chance to have a chat with her.

Snow Black... I haven't had a chance to talk to her since that battle.
I have mixed feelings about her. She dragged me into her dark machinations, but on the other hand, she saved Cinderella. I feel grateful to her, but still...
Idle:
Oh... You must have been really tired.
Hehe, it's not bad to watch over someone's sleep for a change. I'm usually the one being watched, but I think I could get used to this.

IbarahimeSwimsuit02.Name: Sleeping Beauty
IbarahimeSwimsuit02.Profile:
Lanterns rise up to the night sky, carrying the hopes of those who lit them. Nightmare Beauty looks at them and wonders why people wish for things beyond their reach, as if her own past had faded from her memory.
"Sometimes the dreams you thought were unattainable do come true. And since a miracle like that has already happened here, I think my work is done. Even so... Would you mind if I came to see you every now and then, on a fleeting summer night?"
IbarahimeSwimsuit02.Profile_Ascended: "For both me and the other me to be here at the same time—it must be a summer night's dream. Still, Cinderella, I want you to know that you're just as loved when only one me is around. Because my feelings for you would be enough for two people. I—we—care for you more than anyone in the world, please remember that, okay? That is one thing I know no one can beat me at, hehe."

RapunzelRegular01.Name: Rapunzel
RapunzelRegular01.Profile:
In her tower in the woods, Rapunzel is waiting for her soulmate. She doesn't know his name nor his face, but she knows she is bound to meet him one day. She lets her lovely song unfold from the top of her tower, wishing he would hurry up and find her already.
When Rapunzel's true love finally arrives, perhaps her long, beautiful hair will act as the hand of fate, bringing them together at last.
RapunzelRegular01.GachaIntro:
If lies are the seed of betrayal...
is truth the seed of fate, I wonder?

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Light element units have their max HP increased by 10%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:
Targets 1 enemy and ignores Guardians. If no enemies are sleeping, deals 100% damage, and then grants that enemy the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. Sleep will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. If an enemy is sleeping, deals 400% damage instead, Weakens the target and grants the user a Power Charge.

Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. Weakening will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on the target and can be overwritten by Enrage effects. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects.

Power Charges can be consumed by certain skills to activate or enhance their effects. Power Charges will be removed if this unit leaves the battlefield. Power Charges cannot stack.

Removes negative status effects like Sleep, Burn or Poison from 2 other allies and grants them either a Sleep Ward or Poison Ward at random. If a status effect is removed by this skill, the user is Enraged. Allies gain 1 Spirit for each status effect removed by this skill. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

An Enraged unit's attack is increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn. Enrage will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects on the user. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. Cannot be used if the user is alone on the battlefield, and will not remove negative status effects from the user if they are targeted.

500% damage to 2 enemies. If the user has a Power Charge, it will be consumed to deal 750% damage instead. This attack ignores damage reduction effects. Removes Burn and Poison status effects (including Lethal Poison) from the user and grants the user Recovery Mist for 100TU. Recovery Mist effects do not stack. Usable if the user has a Power Charge or a Burn or Poison status effect.

A unit with Recovery Mist will heal for 5% of their max HP and have a 30% chance to be Purified after every turn.

This attack ignores Guardians. 600% damage to 1 enemy if they are awake after having fallen asleep while on the battlefield. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Burn status effects. If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or other status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit will heal 30% of max HP on every ally turn.

Each time a sleeping enemy gets the turn, removes Sleep status effects from this unit and this unit is Enraged.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Reduces the amount of any stun effects against this unit by 20TU.
Can use weapon skills of Axes in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
Ah! Ah, my prince, we meet at last! I have spent countless lonely days and nights waiting for this joyous moment!
My name is Rapunzel. I am your most devoted servant. Only...if you ever betray me, I'll have to cut you into tiny little pieces.
Login:
Where were you so long, my prince? I was fraught with worry...
Next time, I will go with you!
No matter the time, destination, or the means of your travel!
Tap:
What I dislike? Why, dishonesty, of course.
What I like? Well... I like it when my prince and I are together and...
Oh, no... No, no, I couldn't possibly say, my prince!
...I enjoy weaving fantasies, I suppose.

What's the name of that maid who would do anything for Marshall Ludmilla?
I believe the two of us would get along famously!

Did you know? Princess Talia is my friend now too! 
Ah, there she is!
...Um, excuse me? Aren't you two standing a bit too close to each other?
Idle:
My prince has vanished...
What if I never hear him call my name again...? Or say such sweet things about my hair?
No, no, no...!
Oh, the uncertainty fills my heart with such dread...

RapunzelRegular02.Name: Rapunzel
RapunzelRegular02.Profile:
She often climbs to the top of her tower. The night sky seems so close from there... But she still can't reach the stars, and with the additional distance from the ground, she feels even more lonely than usual; painfully aware that she won't be leaving this place, not today.
She wonders if her beloved stars watch her sometimes, just like she watches them.
RapunzelRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
She counts the stars over and over again. She's always yearned for the night sky, even though the ground is so much closer, solid and true. Once she's done counting, she lies down, but sleep tends to evade her, so she escapes into one of her usual reveries.
"Isn't it odd? I may not know your face, but I would recognize your scent and the warmth of your embrace anywhere..."

LuBuRegular01.Name: Lü Bu
LuBuRegular01.Profile:
She was a girl with no name, just a number carved into her skin. Until one day she killed the adults that chained her, burned the walls that confined her, destroyed everything that stood in her way to freedom.
She did whatever she needed to stay alive, and threw away what she didn't need anymore without hesitation. And people called it duplicity, they called it betrayal. Before she knew it, she had gained a name, and the name had gained notoriety.
Perhaps the number on her skin has been an evil omen from the start...
LuBuRegular01.GachaIntro:
Betrayal breeds betrayal and more betrayal
Love breeds hate and nothing more

LuBuRegular02.Name: Lü Bu
LuBuRegular02.Profile:
She doesn't have any positive emotions left now, but she used to have them once. She used to have someone she cared about.
Lü Bu often thinks about the girl who shared her fate as a child; wonders where she might be now, what she's doing these days... Constant enemy attacks have left her with no illusions, though—with too many betrayals on her record, Lü Bu doesn't have anywhere to go anymore.
Except for the land across the sea.
LuBuRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
"What if I had been the one who got on the boat that day? What if the two of us had got onto it together...?"
Away from the hustle and bustle of the world, in a place hidden from the constant struggle of her life, Lü Bu indulges in what-ifs. Dreamlike lotus flowers embrace her gently, their petals fresh and unfaded, like the deepest corners of her heart.

MusashiRegular01.Name: Musashi
MusashiRegular01.Profile:
She was a girl with no name and no memory of her past. A certain samurai found her washed up on the shore and gave her the name Musashi, along with his own surname, Miyamoto. In return, she called him "Master." She mimicked his techniques in a naive, earnest way, befitting a child with no past to rely on.
She made new memories every day, while the old ones stayed forgotten.
MusashiRegular01.GachaIntro:
Start at nothing and arrive back at nothing
That is how you attain true emptiness

Gacha:
I'm Musashi Miyamoto. Oni Slayer.
I will accompany you from now on.

I still have a long way to go as a warrior, but one day I will attain true emptiness and become a proper master of the blade.
Login:
Ah, there you are.
Don't wander off alone like that. You might get lost!

Tap:
You say I'm pretty?
What makes a person "pretty"...?

You want to know what "true emptiness" is? It's about discarding all attachments to this world...and so on, and so forth...
A-Anyway, I'm sure you'll understand if we continue our sparring!

Oh, you can thread a needle... You're really good with your hands.
Me? Uh, um... Just thinking about it makes me sweat.
Idle:
Adopt the stance of not adopting a stance... Hmm, yes... With this concept—Wait... Where am I?
Ugh, not again... Where is everybody?

MusashiRegular02.Name: Musashi
MusashiRegular02.Profile: A certain girl calls Musashi by a number. She is surrounded by scary adults, with nowhere to run, nowhere to hide— "You get lost in dreams as easily as in the waking world, kid," her master's words used to wake her from her nightmares, his smile soothing her fears. And now, he has left her too, gone where she cannot follow, before she could gain the full mastery of his teachings. Luckily, he left behind The Book of Five Rings, a treatise to guide her steps.
MusashiRegular02.Profile_Ascended: The Book of Five Rings contained the arcana of the Dual Heaven Style swordsmanship. When Musashi first heard that its ultimate secret is emptiness, she stated that she already had nothing. But her master said it's not simply about the lack of things, it's about the lack of fixed existence. He added that in order to attain it, she'll need to confront her past one day. KingArthurSwimsuit02.Profile:
A familiar figure appeared over Kay, blocking out the sun and his view of the clear skies. Judging by the menacing aura he could sense, he concluded that it must be his former king, changed after obtaining the power of Avalon. And then, the figure spoke.
"Don't you think you have slept enough, brother?"
Kay jerked awake, shaken by what he had witnessed in his dream."Stop meddling with people's heads, you blasted incubus..." he mumbled to himself before closing his eyes again.
KingArthurSwimsuit02.Profile_Ascended: The Knights of the Round Table were spending one of their rare days off at the royal swimming pool—Kay lounging under a beach umbrella, Gawain devouring a generous serving of fried noodles, Lancelot preparing to take a dive from the springboard, and Gareth floating idly in her swim ring. At one point, they all noticed the absence of their king, only to spot her swimming gracefully a short distance away. When she reached their end of the pool, four hands stretched out in her direction, offering to help her get out of the water. And though it might have been a trick of the summer sun, the knights could swear that in that moment her face was brightened by a smile.

Hehe, what's the matter?

CinderellaSwimsuit02.Name: Cinderella
CinderellaSwimsuit02.Profile:
As it turned out later, Talia had been called to the dream world to deal with an emergency. Unaware of that at the time—and thoroughly displeased—Cinderella sat on the sand to stare at the sea. She stayed like that for a long while, ignoring occasional compliments and pick-up lines, and mulling over one concern.
"Is Talia...embarrassed to be seen with me?"
CinderellaSwimsuit02.Profile_Ascended:
And so, a secret wish sprouted in Cinderella's heart—she wanted social status that would allow her to stand by Talia's side as an equal. However, when an opportunity finally came to make this wish come true...she let it go voluntarily.
Because by that time, she had realized there was no reason to be ashamed of her current self—the one Talia was so fond of.

Tap: Please, don't push yourself too hard. If you're tired, just say a word, and I'll give you a back rub. I'll be happy to pat your head too, if you'd like.

You're injured!
"It's just a scratch"? I don't think so. It must be disinfected immediately.
Oh, I shouldn't have left your side...
Ms. Napoleon said she'd be fine on her own, but I wonder if she's taking care of herself properly... I should check in on her soon.
Idle: I can hear Mr. Monster's voice... I may have to leave your side for a while... But even Mr. Monster can't stop me from protecting you.

NapoleonRegular01.Name: Napoleon
NapoleonRegular01.Profile:
Having scored 32 victories in 32 battles, the first Empress of Lugrasse celebrated her success by commissioning a portrait.
In a word, she's a genius. Undefeated as a military officer, she continued her string of triumphs after ascending the throne—whatever she declared she'd do, she was sure to achieve. And the people of Lugrasse loved her for it.
NapoleonRegular01.GachaIntro:
Nothing can stand in her way to supremacy,
for no possibility can escape her notice

Gacha:
I am Napoleon, the first Empress of Lugrasse. Bold of you to call me here.
Let me see... Ah, yes. You don't have to say a word. You have a goal you want me to help you with, don't you? Opponents you want me to defeat.
Very well! With me by your side, nothing is impossible!
Login:
No... I don't want that... Ha!
What is it? Have you come to pay your respects?
Hm? I was "acting strange"?
Nonsense, I was just lost in thought.
Tap: You are burdened with an enormous power, and yet you choose to bear it as yourself, with no mask to hide behind. You don't dwell on what is possible and what isn't, you just do what you believe is right. I must admit, I find your strength quite dazzling...

My special ability? Oh, it is quite simple. I can find out everything there is to know about anything, by taking a single glance.
Amazing, isn't it? And there are no drawbacks. I just always have a lot of information to deal with in my head.

Are you getting along with everyone here, R'lyeh? I see, good. A smile suits you well.
I feel at ease here too. Like I can forget about my ability for a while.
Idle:
Yaaawn... Oh, you fell asleep too? Hmm, maybe that's why I was able to clear my head so easily.
Well, since I have such a first class sleeping spot today, I should probably...make the most of it... Zzzz... Zzzz...

NapoleonRegular02.Name: Napoleon
NapoleonRegular02.Profile:
The girl Napoleon had been before she became a soldier, and later a monarch, didn't seem all that different from who she is now—and yet, she was not the same at all.
In her own words, she can grasp a thousand facts with a single glance; and with each glance, her mind gets flooded with information. The difference is, in the past it was all she could do not to fall apart when faced with her own uncontrollable intellect and the countless phenomena the world had to offer.
NapoleonRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
Once the applause has died down and the audience has left the theater, the empress takes off her crown and lets her mask slip.
Before her rise to power, Napoleon lethargically drifted through life, all her attention focused on not letting herself be overwhelmed with the excess of information in her head. Until one day, she realized she was essentially just waiting for herself to finally snap, and decided she wasn't going to let that happen. And so, she found herself a role to play, one that could give her restless mind a different purpose—the virtuous ruler her fellow countrymen had sought.

CleopatraDark01.Name: Dark Cleopatra
CleopatraDark01.Profile:
Aeon Lords aren't all created the same; some receive their Eternity simply to spread destruction during the Pandemonium, some for other purposes. Cleopatra was the latter—she was tasked with monitoring heads of state around Erden.
And so, she travels the world, asking the same question wherever she goes—a question that happens to mean a lot to her personally.
"What is a nation—its ruler or its people?"
CleopatraDark01.GachaIntro:
When she gazes into the void,
the void cannot resist gazing back

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Earth element units have their Attack increased by 10% and max HP increased by 7%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:
Grants 1 enemy the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU, and the user is granted Stealth, and a Stealth Shield. Steals up to 2 Spirit from enemies.

This will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.

Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
10% less damage from attacks by units equipped with Greataxes.
Can use weapon skills of Swords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
Shush now... Honestly, to think I'd run into you on a job...
What job? Isn't it obvious? Espionage.
Naturally, I'd rather you didn't tell anyone. We're accomplices now, aren't we?
Login:
Well then, let's get to work.
Hm? Am I here because I lost my kingdom? Hehe, that's not possible. A woman has many faces, that is all.
Tap: My mission to infiltrate other nations? It was part of my agreement with my late master, but above all, I do it for the sake of my beloved country. You see, the fight begins long before the war is declared.

Cthulhu... A trace of that malevolent god's presence remains within me. I wish it didn't...
First my former master, then this thing... It seems the divine just cannot get enough of me.

I forced you to be my accomplice, and you won't even try to run away or double-cross me?
If only I'd had a subject like you back then... Ah, never mind.
Idle:
I was weak... And that's why I lost everything.
I wonder what my life would've been like if I had met you before I sold my soul to the devil...

CleopatraDark02.Name: Dark Cleopatra
CleopatraDark02.Profile:
Cleopatra didn't only gaze into the void; she was marked by it.
Within the void, there was a creature of dread and madness. People who lay their eyes on it couldn't think clearly, and those who were touched by it were driven completely mad.
Aeon Lords can rely on their Eternity to heal physical wounds, but even it cannot easily mend a shattered mind. Caught in an endless cycle of death, rebirth, anxiety and madness, Cleopatra eventually forgot even her own name.
CleopatraDark02.Profile_Ascended:
Before she became an Aeon Lord, Cleopatra used to be a pure-hearted woman. She believed the world was inherently good, and was ready to sacrifice everything for the sake of her beloved nation. But she was betrayed by her advisors and the very people she devoted herself to. And that was what it took for the well-meaning queen to fall.
No matter how much fear Cthulhu subjected her to, she wouldn't sink into despair—because she had already reached its utter depths and emerged victorious.

A warrior whose name alone would terrify even the fiercest oni into submission—the famed vice-commander of the Shinsengumi.
Righteous and relentless, she was as stern with her comrades as she was with herself. She was the one who created the group's strict code of conduct, and, by enforcing it, transformed a band of rogues into a warrior elite.
The truth is, strictness was her way of showing them her affection.

Raise our banner and uphold your truth—
The Shinsengumi are not finished yet

She swore that she wouldn't let a single death go to waste and kept fighting, even when she became the last Shinsengumi member left alive.

OkitaRegular02.Name: Okita
OkitaRegular02.Profile:
Okita has always distrusted people—after all, in a world terrorized by the oni, her parents were killed by humans. Abandoned by her relatives, she ended up growing up at a sword school. There, her extraordinary talent was discovered, but it didn't take long for the other disciples to start avoiding her, not even trying to match her in a duel. Soon, she was out of her mind with boredom.
And then one day, a certain girl joined the school—one not afraid to face Okita head on.
She would go on to become Shinsengumi's vice-commander, and the object of Okita's feelings.
OkitaRegular02.Profile_Ascended: Heavens gifted Okita with a wealth of talent, but weren't as generous with her lifespan. The rapid advance of her illness couldn't be concealed for long, and soon she was removed from active service. "I wish I could live longer." "I wish I could still fight." "...I wish I could die by her side." Okita knew that if she was offered a chance to fulfill those wishes, she'd stop at nothing to take it.

KaguyahimeSwimsuit01.Name: Kaguya
KaguyahimeSwimsuit01.Profile:
It's Kaguya's first time seeing the sea, and her first time wearing a swimsuit as well. She has spent most of her life isolating herself from the outside world, but she didn't mind missing out on things—not if it meant she could save Erden.
Now she is standing next to someone very special to her, and her eyes are sparkling with joy. It's hard to believe that making her smile once seemed as impossible as the tasks she gave all her suitors.
KaguyahimeSwimsuit01.GachaIntro:
I'd come to see you without a second thought,
even if you were light years away.
I wonder if you know that...

How have you been? Are you feeling well? Have you been eating properly—

KaguyahimeSwimsuit02.Name: Kaguya
KaguyahimeSwimsuit02.Profile:
Why did Kaguya ask Finn to bring her a moon stone? Because to her, the moon looked just as lonely as she felt. However, the moon wasn't alone at all—it could always count on the sun to lend it its light.
Kaguya, a rabbit from space, tries hopping around just like Erden's rabbits do, and then immediately turns bright red. Himiko must have put her up to it—which, when you look past the embarrassment, proves that Kaguya is no longer alone either.
KaguyahimeSwimsuit02.Profile_Ascended:
Kaguya might not be alone anymore, but she still feels lonely at times. When the object of her affection isn't with her, she goes on solitary walks in the nearby bamboo grove—the place where she landed when she first came to Erden, and where she received her name. She can always find her peace of mind there.
Saving Erden has been her sole goal for a long, long time, but now that there's no need for that, she must face another challenge—her own future, and the feelings dwelling in her heart.

LudmillaNew01.Name: Ludmilla
LudmillaNew01.Profile: At that moment, Ludmilla should have died. But even as she found herself falling to the bottom of the valley, she felt no fear. She only felt pride from saving her fellow Red Dragon Knights through her sacrifice, and she had no doubt that her comrades would be able to carry on without her.
LudmillaNew01.GachaIntro: Let us walk together, our path bathed in light

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:
75% Damage to 1 enemy. Damage doubles for each charge the user has stored (600% max). Then the user is granted 1 charge and the Counter Stance status effect for 300TU.

Counter Stance will overwrite other status effects on the user. For 300TU, the next time the unit with counter stance takes damage from an enemy attack, it will become their turn. Certain skills are affected by and may consume charges. A unit can store a maximum of 3 charges, and all charges are removed from a unit that leaves the battlefield.

600% damage to 2 enemies. Heals all allies for 500% of the user's attack if damage is dealt. Weakened units have their Attack reduced to 0.75x until the end of their next turn. The effect of Weakening may be diminished if the affected unit's Attack is increased by other effects and it can be overwritten by Enrage effects.

Usable if at least 1 other ally on the battlefield has less than 50% of max HP and if the user has no ally Guardian on the battlefield.

Removes negative status effects like Sleep, Burn or Poison from 1 ally. Then grants them a Purify Chain if there is no Purify Chain among allies. A unit with a Purify Chain will Purify another random ally after their turn, then they will pass the Purify Chain to that ally. Purify Chains will end only if the unit with the Purify Chain is defeated, leaves the battlefield, or falls asleep. This skill becomes locked for 10TU after use.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
When this unit enters the battlefield and at the end of each turn, if there is no ally Guardian on the battlefield, this unit will become a Stun Absorber (Whenever any ally would be affected by stun, this unit takes the stun instead). At end of each turn, if there is an ally Guardian on the battlefield, this unit will stop being a Stun Absorber.

This unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks, and is not affected by damage reduction effects granted by ally Barrier type skills.

Grants all other allies 35% damage reduction from attacks while this unit is on the battlefield and there is no Guardian among allies. This effect does not stack with itself if another ally has this passive skill, or with other Barrier type skills.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, Weaken all enemies. If this unit survives until after the end of the turn with more than 1 HP, this unit will gain 1 Charge and heal 30% of max HP.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
10% less damage from attacks by units equipped with Greatswords.
Can use weapon skills of Greatswords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
I'm Ludmilla, Marshall of the Red Dragon Knights...
and an Avatar of Light.

To be frank, I can't use my new powers very well yet.
But practice makes perfect!
I will master them in no time and protect you
no matter what, you have my word.
Login:
You're back! Hello! I've been waiting for you.
Come on, another lovely day of training awaits!
Tap: I really should've died back then. To think I'd be rescued by a Primordial... It was nothing short of a miracle.

I might have become an Avatar of Light, but my heart stayed with the Red Dragon Knights.
My knights are scattered around the world right now, but I'm sure we will gather under the same banner again one day. I'll keep fighting to make that happen.

Good job on today's drills! As a reward, I cooked a little something for you. Eat up, haha!
...What is it? Why are you so pale all of a sudden?
Idle: What's wrong? Is it about my new clothes? Ugh, this is making me nervous... If I look weird, you should just tell me!

LudmillaNew02.Name: Ludmilla
LudmillaNew02.Profile:
And before she knew it, the ground below was right before her. The moment of her death had arrived. But in that very moment, she heard a voice, one that seemed divine and full of light. 
Then, all went dark.
LudmillaNew02.Profile_Ascended:
Ludmilla escaped her fate only because a divine being, the Primordial of Light, decided that the world still needed her presence. By making Ludmilla their Avatar, they saved her life.
She found herself confused by her newfound powers, and the wound from her fall refused to heal, causing her pain. Nevertheless, her resolve was unchanged and unbroken.
"As long as my heart continues to beat, I will always get back up, stronger than before!"

TristanRegular01.FullName: Tristan - Troubadour of the Round Table
TristanRegular01.Profile: "Like a gust blowing silver petals across the battlefield..." That is how the knights of other nations describe the beautiful, but also terrifying sight of Tristan in battle. The invisible blades of sound that she creates can cut through multiple enemies at once, painting the ground beneath them with crimson.

The sweet melody she commands
is the herald of death

TristanRegular02.Name: Tristan
TristanRegular02.FullName: Tristan - Troubadour of the Round Table
TristanRegular02.Profile: The noble house of Tristan has always served as the right hand of the king, and it was only natural that the young Tristan would be entrusted with being a companion and sparring partner of Princess Leidram. Despite being a confidante to the future king from a young age, even she hardly ever witnessed Leidram showing any genuine emotion.
TristanRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
Being the Round Table's greatest musician, Tristan was especially popular amongst the populace of Camelot. Little did they know that she was actually terrified of being the center of attention.
"I-I know this is an important ceremony, but I... I'm feeling sick to my stomach... Could I please sit this one out?"

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Water element units have their Attack increased by 15%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription: 200% damage to 1 enemy. 500% damage instead if the user has not yet defeated an enemy with an attack while on the battlefield. Heals the user for 30% of max HP. If an enemy is sleeping, grants the target the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and does not wake up sleeping enemies.

Grants 1 enemy the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This will overwrite other status effects on that unit.

Then if that target is not asleep (e.g. due to a Sleep Ward), exchanges them with an Imposter. The exchanged enemy will be sent to a random place in line of enemy reinforcements. This exchange will fail if the target is Immovable or if there are less than 4 enemies on the battlefield (no imposter will be added). This skill becomes locked after use until the user uses another active skill.

600% damage to 2 enemies if they are sleeping, this damage will not wake up sleeping enemies. This attack ignores damage reduction effects. The user recovers HP to 100% of its own max if damage is dealt to a sleeping target. If damage is dealt to 2 sleeping targets, the user will immediately get the next turn by having its TU reduced to 0, and this skill will become locked until the user damages an enemy with another attack.

600% damage to 1 enemy. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies. This skill is usable if all enemies are sleeping or if the user has survived 200TU on the battlefield. This skill becomes locked for 75TU after use.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
This unit cannot be defeated by damage from Poison or Burn status effects. If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP. While this unit has 50% or more of max HP, it has 65% damage reduction from attacks.

Each time a sleeping enemy gets the turn, all allies heal for 30% of max HP.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn with more than 1 HP, this unit becomes Enraged, and will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1 HP, Endure effects cannot stack. This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on this unit. Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.

When this unit is defeated by an enemy, 1 random non-sleeping enemy is granted the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This effect triggers again for each time this unit has defeated an enemy with an attack while on the battlefield (max of 4 triggers total). Then if all enemies are asleep, all allies on the battlefield will immediately get the turns by having their TU reduced.

This unit has a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to immediately have its TU reduced to 0 after the first enemy turn while this unit is on the battlefield. If this successfully triggers, the enemy unit that had the turn is also granted the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield.

When this unit defeats 1 or more enemy units with an attack:
- All allies are healed for 30% of max HP.
- If no enemies are sleeping, 1 random enemy is granted the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
10% less damage from attacks by units equipped with Spears.
Can use weapon skills of Spears in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
My name is Tristan.
I am one of the Knights of the Round Table.
...
...
...U-Um, I apologize! It's not that I don't want
to talk to you, it just takes time for me to feel
at ease with new people...
Login:
Ah, finally! Welcome back!
This place is scary without you... All these people I don't know...
S-So! What do you want to talk about today?
Tap:
Shall I play you a song?
I may not look like it, but I'm a composer.
Who did I write this piece for? I-It's a secret!

"The weather's lovely today, isn't it?"
Ah! How long have you been here?
I-I was just practising my small talk skills, that is all!
Princess Leidram is the only person I never felt anxious around, not even at first. Now that I think about it, maybe I could always sense that she wasn't really human...
Idle: Um, if I may... Please, don't abandon me just because I'm not an interesting conversation partner... If you give up on me, I don't think I will ever recover!

ExcaliburRegular01.Name: Excalibur
ExcaliburRegular01.Profile:
Excalibur's memories from before she was sealed reach far into the past.
There once was a girl she called a friend. They played together on the isolated island that was their birthplace and only home.
ExcaliburRegular01.GachaIntro:
Are you my wielder?
If so, my life is yours to use

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Dark element units have their Attack increased by 10% and max HP increased by 7%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription: Damage to all enemies. Adds 3 Super Kuromoris to the very end of the allied reinforcements, and the user's Attack is increased to 1.5x until the end of its next turn. This will overwrite the effects of other Enrage skills on the user.

500% damage to 2 enemies, and adds 1 Super Kuromori to the very front of the allied reinforcements. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects. Usable only if there is an ally Mori on the battlefield or a Mori in the very back of allied reinforcements.

600% damage to 1 enemy, and adds 1 Super Kuromori to the very front of the allied reinforcements. This attack ignores any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated. Unlocked each time an enemy on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source. This skill is locked again after each use unless it defeats an enemy. This skill is also locked again if the user leaves the battlefield.

Grants all enemies the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU, and Purifies (removes negative status effects like Sleep, Burn or Poison) all allies. Unlocked each time a Mori ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, even if the Mori was Ephemeral. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

This unit heals for 10% of max HP, each time an ally hits an enemy with an attack.

Whenever an ally Mori enters the battlefield from reinforcements, this unit heals 10% of max HP.

Whenever a non-sleeping ally gets the turn, this unit will gain Stealth and a Stealth Shield at the end of that turn. Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on the user. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
10% less damage from attacks by Light units.
Can use weapon skills of Greataxes in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
I am Excalibur. I am a weapon created to destroy
the wicked Last Faerie of Avalon.

You are my wielder. Command me as you will.
I will serve you until I break.
Login:
Welcome back.
This is what one should say, is that right?
I heard the words do not carry much meaning, but it feels nice to hear them, and to say them.
Humans are...curious.
Tap: I spent some time with Lucifer in the past. I was supposed to guard her on Morgan's orders. But she deceived me and sealed me up. For some reason, it makes my chest feel tight.
My face is all dirty? That is because Mikaela was teaching me how to cook. But at one point she turned really pale and vanished. Curious.
What would I do if I could fulfill my mission without getting destroyed? Hmm... I never thought of that. I wonder if I am allowed to have this kind of future...
Idle: Hey. Is there anything you want me to do? No? Oh. No, it is fine. I just... No, never mind.

ExcaliburRegular02.Name: Excalibur
ExcaliburRegular02.Profile:
One day, Excalibur's friend took her to the coast.
"Let's leave this place together," she said. They took a boat and went into the unknown, in search of adventure. But this is where Excalibur's memories come to an abrupt end—she was betrayed and sealed in a cave in a faraway land.
ExcaliburRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
While she was sealed, Excalibur's mind was blank. And then, she remembered everything.
She was a weapon created by Morgan. Her purpose was to kill her "friend" if she ever got out of control.
All her pleasant memories faded, and so did her feelings.

ExcaliburMinion01.Profile:
A guardian spirit with the power of Darkness.
Enjoys stargazing.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription: Grants the Poison status effect to 1 enemy. Allies gain 1 Spirit. This will overwrite other status effects on that unit.
Sends user away from the battlefield to the very end of allied reinforcements. Usable once per battle, and only if there are 1 or more allied reinforcements left.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription: This unit is a Guardian. For any enemy attack that would hit 1 or 2 other allies, this unit has a 100% chance to redirect 1 hit to itself instead. This unit will not redirect skills that don't deal damage.

This unit is never considered to be defeated by attacks and does not trigger any skills of other units whenever it is defeated or sacrificed by any source while on the battlefield.

This unit will be fully healed after each turn if it takes damage but is not defeated. This unit will be defeated after any ally or enemy turn if this unit has any of the Burn, Super Poison, or Mega Poison status effects.

Damage dealt to this unit is increased to 2.5 times the normal amount.

RoundTableKnightDark01.Name: Dark Lancelot
RoundTableKnightDark01.Profile: When the power of the Last Faerie of Avalon warped Lancelot's soul, her preferences were completely reversed. She started inflicting pain just as enthusiastically as she had once sought it.

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Dark element units have their Attack increased by 15%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:

Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on that enemy. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison.

This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect and the effects of Skin passive skills. 450% damage if the user has defeated 1 unit with an attack while on the battlefield, 600% if the user has defeated 2+ units. Grants all Mega Poisoned enemies Lethal Poison for 999TU. Then, grants all Super Poisoned enemies Mega Poison for 200TU. Then grants Super Poison to all other enemies that were hit.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.
Stuns 2 enemies for 100TU and grants them the Mega Poison status effect for 200TU. This skill can be redirected by enemy Stun Absorbers. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
This unit cannot fall asleep if there are any Water enemies on the battlefield. Each time a poisoned enemy gets the turn, this unit heals for 20% of its max HP.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Reduces the amount of any stun effects against this unit by 20TU.
Can use weapon skills of Spears in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
Lancelot has arrived, in all her dark glory!
My specialty is not letting my prey die quickly♪
It's about the dread on their faces before I kill them...
How about you? Would you like a taste of the finest torment in the kingdom?
Login: Good news! Some really strong, tough warriors are going to face us in battle today. Hehe, perfect targets... Shall we go?♪
Tap: I need to be more open about my desires! I've been too timid about them until now. It's time to unleash the real me!
I will do whatever my king orders me to. Although... I may defy her if she were to order me to kill someone quickly... I mean, where is the fun in that?
The Code of Chivalry? I don't remember such a thing at all. It's best to live according to one's desires!
Idle:
Don't leave me alone like that...
Although, I suppose I can see the appeal. Yes, torture someone until they cannot move and then just leave them... Hehe... Hehehe♪

RoundTableKnightDark02.Name: Dark Lancelot
RoundTableKnightDark02.Profile:
Faces contorted in pain, voices begging for mercy, limbs shaking with fear—it all brought the new Lancelot pleasure. But whatever was left of the old her still screamed somewhere within her.
"Stop it! This is not who we are! We should be on the receiving end of thiiis!"
RoundTableKnightDark02.Profile_Ascended:
You'd think some event from her childhood must have made her enjoy pain...and you'd be wrong. She was just born this way.
A genuine, natural pervert.

LuciferRegular01.Name: Lucifer
LuciferRegular01.Profile: The Last Faerie of Avalon, once kept sealed deep beneath the island. She is the core of what has come to be known as the Curse of Avalon—hence her brother Morgan's decision to hide her from the world and those who'd be eager to abuse her power.
LuciferRegular01.GachaIntro: Um... W-Would you like to be my friend?

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Fire element units have their Attack increased by 15%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription: 100% damage to all enemies, 250% damage instead if the user is burning, or to targets that are burning. This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, the effects of Skin passive skills, and heals the user for 100% of total damage dealt. This is not considered a Burn Blast type skill.

Burns 1 Enemy, then Stuns them randomly for either 50TU or 200TU if they are Burning. That target is granted a Stun Hex, which will stun all enemies for 100TU at the end of that targets next turn, then be removed. Allies gain 2 Spirit. This skill has no effect if it targets a Water enemy, and is usable only if there is no Stun Hex among enemies. Stun Hexes cannot be purified, and will be removed if the hexed unit is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with burn will also become burned.

750% damage to 1 enemy. The user gains the Mega Healing Burn status effect for 100TU if the user is not burning. This attack ignores effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated. Usable only if all enemies on the battlefield are burning or if the user is not burning.

A unit with Mega Healing Burn will heal after each turn at 20 times the rate as Healing Burn. This will overwrite other status effects on the user, cannot be overwritten by Burn, Poison or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified. Any unit that deals damage to or is dealt damage by a unit with Mega Healing Burn will gain the Burn status effect. A unit with Mega Healing Burn will be granted Healing Burn for 300TU when Mega Healing Burn expires.

500% damage to 2 enemies, and the user will also Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack. This attack ignores damage reduction effects.

At the end of the turn, allies that are either Fire element or have Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skills will gain the Burn status effect, and all other allies will have Burn removed. Unlocked each time a non-conjured ally on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
At the end of each turn, this unit grants a random non-burning, non-water ally on the battlefield the burn status effect. Then a random burning ally will heal for 30% of their max HP.

At the end of each other ally turn, if all ally units are burning, this unit will immediately get the next turn by having its TU reduced to 0, then this effect cannot trigger again until 20TU advances.

All Fire Allies and Allies with Burn Blast and Burn Drive type active skills are Quickened by 30% when this unit enters the battlefield, or when those allies enter from reinforcements while this unit is on the battlefield. This will overwrite the effects of other Quicken skills on affected units.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
10% less damage from attacks by Fire units.
Can use weapon skills of Swords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
I'm... I'm Lucifer. Uh, I'm not wicked or anything...

I don't know what I should say here...
I-If you want to, we could be friends?
I'll be a great friend, I promise!
Login:
Um, sorry if I'm being a bother, but... Can I come with you today?
I can? Really!? Ehehe, I'm so happy!
Tap:
You... You're really kind. You always keep me by your side...
I'd do anything for you, you know?
Maybe I could buy some friends with money... Hmm, but where do they sell friends...? I'm sure Morgan would know, b-but...I'm scared to ask...

"The occult"? You mean ghosts!? What do humans even do when they see such things?
It makes them happy? Um, ghosts are scary...but humans are scarier...
Idle:
Hm? Where is everyone?
R-Right, who would want to sit here with someone like me... It's fine, I don't mind... I don't mind at all...

LuciferRegular02.Name: Lucifer
LuciferRegular02.Profile:
Her underground prison was a dark, lonely place. Even the faeries didn't all know about her existence, and she had no one to talk to aside from Morgan.
Until one day, a certain girl came into her life, and suddenly she wasn't alone anymore.
LuciferRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
Lucifer dreamed about a world where she and her friend could be happy.
One day, the girls escaped Avalon together. However, during their journey Lucifer came to know the truth about her companion's nature: she was a living weapon, created to destroy the Last Faerie of Avalon.
And so, Lucifer decided to strike first. She sealed the weapon—her first friend, her only friend—away in a remote cave.

While this unit is on the battlefield, at the end of this unit or an ally Suimori's turn, all allies will:
- Gain Coral Barrier for 100TU.
- have Burn and Poison status effects (including Lethal Poison) removed.
- be healed for 30% of their max HP.

If this unit is not alone on the battlefield and has Coral Barrier, this unit has a 20% chance, plus 20% chance per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to survive any damage that would defeat it with 1HP.

Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.

GokuBride02.Profile: Wukong couldn't wrap her head around the idea of a robe only meant to be worn for one occasion—especially not for a ceremony performed to unite two people for the rest of their lives. Her mind was always occupied with food, training, Tianzhu, food, Nimbus, food, food, food... She couldn't even imagine herself falling in love.

And yet, a certain name came to her mind—someone she could see herself marry. She shook her head violently.
"This kind of stuff doesn't suit me at all!" she yelled, but just as was about to take the robe off, she heard that person's voice saying, "That's a pity. You'd look so pretty as a bride," and she felt herself turn red as a beet again.
"I wouldn't! Stupid!"

DragonGirlRegular02.Profile: Weary and covered in scars left by battles with her archenemy and countless adversities, the Dragon Lord of Light looked for a place to make her final lair. At last, she reached the mountains, and lived there in peace and solitude for years—until the day the silence of her home was broken by the sound of footsteps.
DragonGirlRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
The intruder introduced herself as Rias. She was a fearless and irreverent girl, and she loved her village more than anything. A certain young man she promised to spend her life with lived there too.
The moment she asked to become the Dragon Lord's next vessel, the young man's face flashed across her mind.
"You've always been popular with the girls," she thought to herself, "I'm sure you'll be fine without me."
Still, a faint memory of him and a hint of longing remained in the depths of the Dragon Lord's soul for years.

HokusaiRegular02.Name: Hokusai
HokusaiRegular02.Profile: Hokusai's parents and everyone who knew her mourned the loss of a future master artist to the Requiem. Hokusai herself felt dejected too. But then, she met Hibiki. HokusaiRegular02.Profile_Ascended: From that moment on, she painted Hibiki and only Hibiki. Expressing her muse's raw beauty through her art became Hokusai's only purpose. To her, Requiem wasn't a long-dreaded hell, but a divine chance to portray Hibiki at the height of her glory. As long as she could leave behind records of true beauty, Hokusai didn't care how much blood she was going to get on her hands.

PerryRegular02.Name: Perry
PerryRegular02.Profile: The eyes of the young Perry always sparkled at the sight of the exotic treasures and minerals her father brought back from his expeditions. She worked hard toward her dream, determined to one day become an adventurer who would explore unknown lands. A year ago, she finally obtained government approval and set out as an adventurer. But around that time, her father, Ganon, vanished without a word, leaving no trace.
PerryRegular02.Profile_Ascended:
She secured a hefty loan from the government, bought a ship, and set off for the open sea—
However, Perry soon realized the truth: if she returned with nothing to show for it, this would quickly turn into nothing more than a high-interest mega-debt cruise.
Since then, she has kept a sharp, watchful eye day and night to ensure not a single piece of equipment goes missing, and the moment she hears a rumor about treasure, she immediately jumps at the opportunity.

300% damage to 1 enemy, and then grants that enemy the Deep Sleep status effect for 100TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield, and heals all allies for 800% of the user's attack. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects. This skill becomes locked for 50TU after use.

Deep Sleep will overwrite other status effects, cannot be overwritten by Burn or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified.

200% damage to all enemies. 500% damage instead to sleeping targets. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect. PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
This unit cannot be burned. This unit's attacks will not wake sleeping enemies.

This unit has 40% damage reduction from attacks, plus 10% for each burning or sleeping enemy on the battlefield (up to 80% max).

When this unit takes damage from an attack, if there are 2 or more enemies that are burning or sleeping on the battlefield, this unit has a 20% chance plus 20% per Awakening (up to 100% chance if this unit has 4 Awakenings) to be immediately Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed, new status effects may still apply following this effect), and get the next turn.

When this unit enters the battlefield and at the end of each turn, if there are 2 or more enemies on the battlefield that are Fire element or have a Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skill, this unit will become a Stun Absorber (Whenever any ally would be affected by stun, this unit takes the stun instead). At the end of each turn, if there are less than 2 enemies on the battlefield that are Fire element or have a Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skill, this unit will stop being a Stun Absorber.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

Each time an ally (including this unit) gets the turn, they will heal for 20% of their max HP. If that ally is Water and survives until after the end of the turn, Allies gain 1 Spirit.

When this unit's attacks hit a sleeping, non-boss, non-Ephemeral target and that target has 1HP remaining after damage, that target is immediately defeated (this unit is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the enemy from being defeated.

When this unit enters battle all allies will be granted Sleep Wards. After the end of this unit's first turn on the battlefield, all allies will have Burn removed and be granted Burn wards. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
10% less damage from attacks by Fire units.
Can use weapon skills of Spears in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

OniSchoolDark01.Name: Hibiki
OniSchoolDark01.Profile: Hibiki Himeno was never discouraged. Not when she became a vessel. Not when the false requiem began. Even in the depths of despair, she laughs, her eyes always lit with the light of the future.

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Dark element units have their Attack increased by 10% and max HP increased by 7%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:
Heals all allies for 800% of the user's attack. Then grants all allies Stealth, a Stealth Shield, Poison Ward, Stun Ward and Burn Ward. Unlocks at random either Toxic Reign or Demon Blast. This skill becomes locked after use until the user uses the Toxic Finale skill or leaves the battlefield.

Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack. Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on affected units. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth.

Removes Burn (including Mega Healing Burn) and Stealth Shields from all enemy units on the battlefield. Then all enemies are granted Mega Poison for 200TU, and Burn Wards. Then 1 random enemy is granted Lethal Poison for 999TU. This skill is locked until it becomes unlocked by Demonic Defiance, and unlocks Toxic Finale upon use. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

Mega Poison will overwrite other status effects on those enemies. Mega Poison deals 20 times the damage of normal Poison and cannot be overwritten by normal Poison or Super Poison. Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects on the affected enemy, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning units or Boss units.

300% damage to 2 enemies. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect. This skill is locked until it becomes unlocked by Demonic Defiance, and unlocks Toxic Finale upon use. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

350% damage to 2 enemies. 700% damage instead to targets that are poisoned. All non-poisoned enemies hit are then granted Lethal Poison for 999TU. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects. This skill is locked until it becomes unlocked by Toxic Reign or Demon Blast. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield. This skill unlocks Demonic Defiance after use.

If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP.

While there is a poisoned enemy on the battlefield, this unit is not affected by stun effects.

At the end of each of this unit's turns:
- A random ally on the battlefield is healed for 30% of max HP.
- A random ally on the battlefield is Enraged. This will overwrite any existing Weak or Enrage effects.
- A random ally on the battlefield will have its TU costs for all of its skills reduced by 20%. This will overwrite the effect of previous quicken skills.

Enraged units have their Attack increased to 1.5x until the end of their next turn.

I'm Hibiki... Hibiki Himeno...
Good, looks like I haven't forgotten that.

Um, how should I put it...
The me right now isn't really the real me...
N-Never mind! Forget I said anything...!

Maybe I know this because of someone's gift...who knows. Well, I'm counting on you, partner!

Ahhh, geez, I really want a crepe!! I could totally handle two loaded with extra cream, right now!
 Actually, maybe I should go get some... Yeah, I'm doing it.

OniSchoolDark02.Name: Hibiki
OniSchoolDark02.Profile:
But what if this body itself was a fabrication?
What if her memories had been forged?
What if there was no actual future in the first place?
Could she still overcome that despair?
OniSchoolDark02.Profile_Ascended:
Now, only one thing is true.
Only one thing anchors her.
The days she spent with her dear friend.
Hibiki resolved to live as long as that friend was alive as well. Even if they were never to meet again.

ElminaModern01.Name: Elmina
ElminaModern01.Profile: Elmina works in the shadows as an special agent of the Red Dragon Organization. An existence of shadows, her missions are primarily espionage and infiltration... at times, even assassination. Only Luther and the upper echelons of the organization know her name. Her very existence is shrouded in secrecy.
ElminaModern01.GachaIntro:
My existence is top secret.
Let it slip... you know what'll happen, right?

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription: 200% damage to 2 enemies, plus 150% for each Charge stored on the user (max of 650% total damage). This attack ignores any enemy status effects (including Stealth), damage reduction effects, and skin passive skills. Heals the user for 100% of total damage dealt. Damage from this attack does not wake up sleeping enemies.

- If this unit is not conjured, it will have Hold Ground (If this unit would be defeated by an enemy attack or a status effect while having more than 1 HP, it instead survives with 1 HP).
- If this unit is not conjured and if there are 4 allies on the battlefield, an Elmina will be added to the front of allied reinforcements.
- If this unit is conjured, this unit will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack.

- All allies will be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed), and heal for 100% of max HP.
- Then all other ally units will be given the next turns by having their TU reduced. Active skills that grant turns cannot be used by those allies until after they have had the turn.

Each time this unit damages at least one enemy with an attack and leaves them on or below 25% of max HP (even if they are defeated by the attack), this unit will get another turn. Damaged targets cannot trigger this effect again until TU advances.

Effects that influence TU order may interrupt extra turns (e.g. Stuns targeting the lowest TU target).

ElminaModern02.Name: Elmina
ElminaModern02.Profile: In the past, Elmina was taken in by the Church as an orphan, tasked with finding and bringing back vessels. Yet, as she came to learn the truth behind the Requiem, she began to feel sympathy for the girls. Eventually, she was taken in by Luther and the Red Dragon Organization, which proclaims the goal of creating a world without vessels. There, she began her path as a special agent.
ElminaModern02.Profile_Ascended:
"Your mission is to capture a girl who holds the fate of the world—and, if necessary, to take her life."
The moment Elmina received this order, she understood that, among the countless assignments she had carried out, this would be the most difficult and painful of them all.

300% damage to 1 enemy, plus 150% for each time this skill has damaged a burning or sleeping enemy while on the battlefield (max of 750% total damage). This attack ignores damage reduction effects, any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

The first time this skill is activated while on the battlefield, the user will get the next turn by having their TU reduced to 0. Then this skill becomes usable only if the user's party has 2 or less Spirit.

Exchanges 1 random non-sleeping, non-immovable enemy with an Imposter. The exchanged enemy will be sent to a random place in line of enemy reinforcements. If this skill is used 3 times within 10TU, it becomes locked for 200TU, minus 25TU per awakening (100TU if the user has 4 Awakenings). Usable only if there are 4 enemies on the battlefield, at least 2 of them are not Imposters, and a valid target exists. Usable 15 times per battle.

500% damage to 1 enemy, and the user is granted a Power Charge. 700% damage instead if the target is sleeping or burning. This attack cannot be redirected by Guardians. This attack ignores the Counter Stance Status Effect, and the effects of Skin passive skills.

If this damage does not defeat the target, the user exchanges that enemy with an Imposter. The exchanged enemy will be sent to a random place in line of enemy reinforcements. This will not trigger if the target is Immovable or if there are less than 4 enemies on the battlefield (no Imposter will be added), and cannot trigger more than 3 times per battle.

Unlocked each time the user damages an enemy with another attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield. Power Charges cannot stack and will be removed when the user leaves the battlefield.

800% damage to 2 enemies, and the user will Endure the next damage that would defeat it with 1HP. Endure effects cannot stack. Minus 100% damage for each enemy on the battlefield that is not burning or sleeping (max of -400% if 4 enemies are not burning or sleeping). If this attack damages a target, the user's Power Charge is consumed. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect. Usable only if the user has a Power Charge.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
This unit cannot be burned, or be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

This unit has 30% damage reduction from attacks. While there is a sleeping or burning enemy on the battlefield, this unit has 60% damage reduction instead.

The first time this unit is damaged by an attack while it does not have its Active Skills disabled, this unit will have its TU reduced to 0.

This unit's attacks:
- Will not wake sleeping enemies.
- Heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.
- Remove burn status effects (including Mega Healing Burn) from hit targets.
- Then grant hit targets the Sleep status effect for 200TU, even if they have already slept while on the battlefield. This effect cannot trigger if Momotaro has no other allies on the battlefield.

This unit cannot be stunned if there is an enemy on the battlefield that is Fire element, or has a Burn Blast or Burn Drive type active skill.

Whenever an imposter on the battlefield is defeated or sacrificed by any source, a random ally will have their current TU reduced by 50TU.

When this unit enters battle, for 150TU:
- This unit cannot be defeated by damage (including Lethal Poison).
- Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 100% of its max HP and be Purified (any negative status effects like sleep, burn or poison are removed).
After 150TU on the battlefield, each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn, this unit will heal for 30% of its max HP and be Purified.

Whenever this unit defeats any number of non-conjured enemies with an attack, this unit will grant the Deep Sleep status effect for 100TU to the next enemy that enters the battlefield. Deep Sleep will overwrite other status effects, cannot be overwritten by Burn or Sleep status effects, and cannot be Purified.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
10% less damage from attacks by Fire units.
Can use weapon skills of Swords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
Hey, are you maybe Momo's little sister...?
I knew it, I knew it, I was right.

Ehehe, from now on you have to call me
"big sis," okay? It's a promise!
Call me "Momotaro," and you'll get a scolding.
Login:
I wonder what kind of little sister I'll get to meet～☆
This kind and that kind... I just can't wait♪ Come on, let's go already!
Tap: I really don't like the code name Momotaro～ I'd rather be called Momo-chan or Momo～

You want to talk about little sisters with me? Sure, what about them should we discuss?
How about... why little sisters are so cute! Or maybe how to find one!

When I was little, my precious little sister went missing once.
I never want to go through something like that again! No matter what means I have to use.
Idle: I think I smell a little sister... from over there... yeah, no mistake... my little sister is over there!  This is my chance!

KingArthurEvil01.Name: King Arthur
KingArthurEvil01.FullName: King Arthur - Revenant of the Round Table
KingArthurEvil01.Profile: Arthur Leidram entered an endless dream woven by Merlin's magic, there she took her final breath. Yes, she had shed the blood of many. But she had striven for her ultimate goal. There were no regrets.
KingArthurEvil01.GachaIntro:
The King returns—
to fulfill the final duty.

LeaderSkill.SkillDescription: Allied Dark element units have their Attack increased by 15%.

ActiveSkill.SkillDescription:
300% damage to 1 enemy, plus 100% for each turn the user has gotten and survived until after the end of the turn on the battlefield (max of 600% total damage). If that enemy is not burning, they will also be granted the Lethal Poison status effect, and become infected with it. This attack ignores damage reduction effects, skin passive skills and the Counter Stance status effect.

After the end of each turn, this infection will trigger to apply Lethal Poison to a random non-burning, non-Lethal Poisoned unit on the infected unit's team. Infection ends after 3 triggers (even if they find no valid target) or once the infected enemy is defeated or leaves the battlefield. Infection is not a status effect and cannot be prevented or purified, but the status effect spread by the infection may be. A unit cannot get a new infection until their existing one ends.

Lethal Poison will overwrite other status effects, lasts 999 TU, cannot be overwritten by status effects other than Burn or Stealth, and cannot be Purified. Lethal Poison deals 2 times the damage of normal Poison, and ignores passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the target from being defeated, other than those which specifically prevent defeat from Poison or non-attack damage. Lethal Poison cannot apply to Burning or Boss units.

Heals all Dark allies for 100% of max HP. The user is granted Stealth, a Stealth Shield, a Sleep Ward, Stun Ward, and Poison Ward. The user's Hold Ground+ passive skill effect is reset for the user and can be triggered again.

When the user activates this skill a third time, a random non-boss, non-Ephemeral enemy on or below 25% of max HP and on the battlefield will be immediately defeated (the user is considered to have defeated that enemy with an attack). This secondary effect ignores Revenge passive skills, Revival passive skills, and any passive skills or effects of active skills that would prevent the random enemy from being defeated.

This skill is locked until the user's Hold Ground+ passive skill effect is triggered while on the battlefield and is locked again after each use. This skill can be used only three times per battle.

Stealth will overwrite other Status effects on the user. Stealth Shields prevent the next non-stealth status effect a unit would gain while Stealthed from applying. Stealthed units ignore the next enemy attack that would damage more than 1 target. Any damage will remove stealth. Each Ward prevents their named effect from being applied once, then is removed. Identical Wards cannot stack.

200% damage to all enemies, plus 100% for each time this skill has already been used while on the battlefield (max of 500% total damage). The user and another random ally are granted Stealth and a Stealth Shield. This attack ignores enemy damage reduction effects and any effects of non-boss enemies that would prevent the target from being defeated.

Unlocked each time the user damages an enemy with another attack. This skill is locked again after each use or if the user leaves the battlefield.

PassiveSkill.SkillDescription:
If this unit would be defeated, it instead survives with 1 HP and then cannot be defeated or stunned until its next turn. This effect can trigger only once each time this unit enters the battlefield, and is considered a Hold Ground+ effect.

This unit's attacks heal this unit for 100% of total damage dealt.

Each time this unit takes damage from an attack and survives until after the end of the turn with more than 1 HP, this unit will immediately get the turn by having its TU reduced to 0. This extra turn may be interrupted by other effects that influence the turn order (e.g. other stuns targeting the lowest TU target). This is not considered a Counter Skin type effect.

This unit enters battle with 10% HP Regen for 200TU, and an Instant Death Ward.

An Instant Death Ward prevents this unit from being immediately defeated without damage by a non-boss enemy once, then is removed. Instant Death Wards cannot be ignored and cannot stack. A unit with 10% HP Regen will heal for 10% of their max HP after every turn. HP Regen effects will overwrite existing HP Regen effects.

This unit's Attack is increased to 1.5x.
This unit's Active Skill TU Costs are reduced by 50%.
This unit has 50% damage reduction from attacks.

All of these effects are triggered when this unit begins on the battlefield at the very start of battle, and will end if this unit leaves the battlefield. This unit cannot be sent to the reinforcements from the battlefield.

-This Attack increase does not stack with Enrage effects.
-This will not reduce TU Costs to below 1TU.
-Quicken effects will not further reduce this unit's TU costs.
Adds 1200 to this unit's max HP.
Adds 300 to this unit's Attack.
10% less damage from attacks by Storm units.
Can use weapon skills of Swords in addition to their original preferred weapon type.

Gacha:
So this is a new curse—
I, King Arthur, have returned.
State your wish.

When my ambitions are fulfilled
then I shall grant your desire.
Login: Head to Camelot once more. Once I am finished there, I shall grant your wish.
Tap: I should be dead... but here I am. Fate is terrifying and, at the same time, filled with hope.

I'm sure that Gawain will be able to guide the kingdom in the right direction.
Hmph, words unbefitting of a ghost...
I wonder what has become of Camelot. If I don't go now, I will surely never see it again...
Idle: There is no concept of sleep for this body... It seems I am truly not human anymore... No—it's more than I could have hoped for...

KingArthurEvil02.FullName: King Arthur - Revenant of the Round Table

Gacha:
Um, I'm Don Quixote, an orderly of the Knights
of the Round Table! I am second to none when it
comes to drive, spirit, and admiration!

I'll burst through any wall...!
Let's charge ahead together!
Login: Here I am at full speed! Um... let's do our best together! So, uh, where are we headed?
Tap:
I love the stories of the Knights of the Round Table!
When I first heard them, I didn't think they were real people... silly of me, right?
Um... I'm generally good with the cold, but... if I freeze, I'll die, so... somewhere warm would be nice...

But the smell is kind of addicting once you get used to it... and it's actually quite valuable in my village...

DonQuixoteRegular02.Name: Don Quixote
DonQuixoteRegular02.Profile: However, as she diligently chopped firewood every day to help her parents, the villagers began to notice that she possessed extraordinary strength. From then on, the village came to rely on her whenever monsters appeared. She felt truly happy to have discovered a talent that allowed her to help others.

With unwavering diligence and unshakable sincerity, she moved the hearts of the villagers. And at the age of eighteen, with their blessings, she finally set off for Camelot.
